Fernando, our waiter, was very helpful with the menu since my dad and I are both gluten free. The menu had a lot of options and Fernando brought out lots of good gluten free bread. He also brought out different complementary appetizers since we couldn't eat the typical bread as well as dessert and champagne. We had to turn down more food from him since we were stuffed from our amazing meals as well. I definitely recommend this place if you are looking to splurge a little on a nice dinner in a nice restaurant.

We arrived in Madrid yesterday with the desire to explore. We picked Los Montes with the idea of interesting food choices and good staff. Our expectations were met 100%. The appetizers we selected, cheese board and pate, were terrific. The host presented a complimentary salmon mouse as well. The house pate was one of the best we have had. Our Reserve wine complimented the appetizers as well as the entrees: pork cheek and Iberica special. Our waiters were attentive without being intrusive. A lovely evening of dining in a tasteful environment make this a top choice. The quiet atmosphere is conducive to conversation but is not at all stuffy, as lively music plays in the background.

A charming restaurant with amazing service and great food. I came twice in a row after discovering it.
Thanks to Fernando for his service and kindness.
I will definitely bookmark this restaurant for future visits.

A « must do » in Madrid. The place is very well decorated, the waiter took great care of us and the food/wine were delicious.
Usually, I do not give any review and I am breaking the habit as our experience in Los Montes de Galicia was wonderful.
Thanks for this great moment!

We booked a table for 6 for Friday evening. The food was simply great , just try the foie gras or the pork ribs , or lasagna , or .. everything. The staff was also very good, Alin the waiter was great , made a pleasurable evening for us!
Highly recommended!

So we got horrible lost finding this gem, and early gave up. Then I found a local and handed him the map and after he rattled off something in Spanish, and some directions in English, he said we will have a great time.....it's an awesome restaurant.

Well he wasn't lying. As soon as we arrived we had ham and bread on the table in minutes, together with some great wine. I ordered mains which was a steak but really after the tapas I was full! Most of us were! The steak was tender and delicious though.

Great decor as well. Desserts were great, but we didn't need do them justice. Had way too much ham! Lol!

I was here with my boyfriend and had the menu for 60 euro inkl wine. We got 6 courses, 2 bottle of wine and brandy. The food was excellent and the service the same. The interiors are so nice. Remember to book a table because they are usually fooled booked. It is a couple of km outside the center of Madrid but it is well worth the taxi drive there

What a night!! We came here expecting a lot (due to its ranking etc. etc.), but what can I say. Food was amazing, but above all, the quality of service proposed by all of the restaurant’s personnel, in particular Daniel who did an AMAZING JOB.

Will definitely return.

Food was great and staff was helpful and friendly.
Our meals where great and the desserts even better.
Thank you Anthony for great service and making our meal a memorable experience

we tried the restayrant through the feedbacks from tripadvisor; the ambiance is wonderful and the staff welcomes you to feel comfortable. we choosed dried beef as begining and baby goat from the main menu which were delicous. the choise of red wine, valenciso reserva 2011 rioja was really good that was recomded by Anthony who served us. Once again thank you for your recomendations and the service Anthony.
Absolutely delicious food and the most incredible service!!! Antonio, Alejandro, Cristian - encantadores y amables!!!! La mejor atención en toda Madrid!!!

Los Montes de Galicia Captivated our interest after reading reviews... we decided to go AND Mario and Carlos captivated and captured our hearts from the moment we sat down. They were both attentive listeners to what our interests would be and they definitely delivered with their recommendations. A delicious appetizer of Camembert with a light raspberry coulis was swiftly delivered. Our appetizer to share ~ cod fish doughnuts for the two of us were a delightful blend of smoothness and light crisp crunch for the coating. What we didn't anticipate was the amazing dinners recommended that truly delivered above and beyond! Wild sea bass had just the right blend of flavor to satisfy leaving no trace of any leftovers as it was just so good. The Pork Feather truly tantalizes your taste buds if you love tender pork with a miso/teriyaki sauce on top of goat cheese. Just the right blend of flavor to satisfy yet could not even finish the portion. Bursting at the seams we truly realized we couldn't eat another bite..... yet the best was yet to come! At this point we were taking a breather from all of the delicious food and truly being full, we were enjoying the conversation with our waiters who truly were delightful with their humor and attentiveness. Next thing we know the house specialty cheesecake magically appeared. Pleasantly surprised we somehow found room to share this delightful dessert. The neighboring tables ordered other desserts and they were raving as well. Needless to say everything was over the top good from start to finish. We decided at that point to make a reservation for one week later for our last night in Madrid before heading home! Thank you to Carlos and Mario for making it a great night and the chefs who make this restaurant an amazing culinary experience!!

High quality in both the food and the service. It was a business dinner starting at 10 pm (very normal in a quality restaurant in Madrid). We were a group of 8 and we all agreed that the food was absolutely good.
Service as well. And the restaurant interior is modern and nice.
There is a lot of excellent choices on the menu and the Price lever is ok for this quality.
A very Nice dinner.

Amazing surprise!when I was looking for a nice place to dinner in Madrid on a Monday I knew most of the good places are closed.Fortunately this was my first choice on those available ...a lot of good feedbacks here made me feel more anxious to get there!the minute I pass the door you can tell ,they are all there waiting for you and to make you feel welcome !the menu was also a good surprise ,a lot of different things to choose for ... hard choice to get one ...in the end,I was not going into the desert ,I was feeling good just with the salmon but Anthony offer me the cheese cake before I leave ... it was really really tasty (that was the cherry on top of the cake)!!! Thank you all for your service and food!!! I will return,for sure !!! Gracias ‼️it’s no surprise now for me why you are in top 3 restaurants (in more than 10200)!!!of the gigantic Madrid !!!

What a fantastic place! Great food, outstading service - thank you Eloy and Antonio - totally reccomended. And try the “Costillas” if you are a mert lover, they are awesome. Leave a place for the chocolate textures, you won’t regreat it ❤️
Crowded restaurant but worth a visit. We came here because of the reviews and we had a lovely meal here. Not all staff speak English but they'll go out of their way to please you.

I don’t write many TripAdvisor reviews, but I wanted to make sure I did so for this restaurant. We had a delicious meal - would highly recommend the ‘cod doughnuts’, goat shoulder and cheesecake, along with the house wines. The service was excellent (Jesus was our expert waiter!) and the place itself was relaxed, friendly and unpretentious. We’ll definitely be back and recommending to friends visiting Madrid!

Our friends in Madrid booked this
dinner for us. Wow! Beautiful decor, great food, Galician with a modern twist (but not too much), great selection of wines and excellent staff. Our waiter, Anthony, had excellent English and gave impeccable service. This was a wonderful meal just out of the “old centre” of Madrid.

Forget the fact this is in the middle of nowhere ( taxi recommended) where the beautifully appointed restaurant opens at 8pm and if you arrive early...there’s nowhere to go beforehand so you queue up outside.

We were welcomed immediately as the doors opened and the standard of service / friendliness was just wonderful.
Thank you Victor for your energetic & happy welcome.

We decided not to have the “22nd year anniversary” meal for 70 euros. ( who celebrates their 22nd year in business ?...looked a bit touristy).

We settled on wonderful ( but expensive) anchovies that were sublime. We were then given an Octopus dish on the house whilst we waited for the mains to arrive. Alin an understated but incredibly patient and knowledgeable waiter helped us choose the feather pork and a sliced steak on goats cheese/ aubergine to share. He suggested that we receive them one at a time and he was so right. Delicious food. Perhaps we should have chosen some salad or vegetables on the side as they come with just a small amount of relish size veg.

Wine was suggested to us ( Temperanillo / Cab Sauv mix) which was delicious ..and a smiling assassin of a wine at 14.5% abv.

We just had coffees at the end..with more freebies ...and were given a gift of a bottle of their house wine to take away in a brown bag...made us feel special until we realised everyone gets one !

If I was cynical I’d say this is an efficiently marketed and run tourist place that knows every marketing trick in the book to make their customers recommend them on trip advisor. But in reality, it was just good food, good wine, great service...and a fun night out in a beautifully appointed restaurant.

They deserve their top status as no. 1 out of 10,500 restaurants in Madrid. Very much recommended.

Great restaurant in an off the beaten track location (the location reminded me of Bell's Diner in Bristol). Great food, the turbot was exceptional, but the stand out about this restaurant is the service. Striking that balance between helpful guidance with real rapour, without feeling like you have someone leaning over you all night...

In a city with many great options for delicious food, Los Montes de Galicia delivers. My husband and I were very happy we dined here during our stay in Madrid. The food is delicious and the service is amazing. Our waiter, Victor, made excellent recommendations for us from the menu and was extremely attentive. Definitely recommended!!

We had the tasting menu which comprised 6 starters, 1 main each, 1 desert each and wine (2 bottles) as well as 2 cocktails for €70pp. This was excellent value as all of the courses were delicious, and the service (by Alin and Rubin) was fantastic! We could not recommend more! Book in advance.

I have to admit that, being this the number one restaurant in Madrid for TripAdvisor I was very curious of what I was going to find. However I have to say that it didn’t surprised me! The Restaurant is well decorated and we were extremely well cared by Jesus, which left me with a good impression about the service. With respect to the food, it was clear that the ingredients were fresh, however it was not surprisingly tasty as it should be expected from a Restaurant with such a reputation. Also I think the prices were above the average expected for a Restaurant like Los Montes de Galicia. So good but not extraordinary.
I have best experience dining in this restaurant, beautiful place with nice decoration, which make impressed us, service on top notch of standards, all of dishs really good one, highly recommend

We had a fabulous dinner there. The service, location and food was beyond expectation. Anthony was responsible for an unforgettable evening, great recommendations and just great atmosphere. He is the kind of guy you want to come back, great job.

Amazing food! The Fish Lasagne was delicious and the cheesecake was divine! Our waiters Antonio and Anthony were very friendly and helpful. Lovely atmosphere and a true food lovers delight! Highly recommended for groups and couples alike.

This place is perfect from the beautiful mind blowing food to the ambient and the service!!
A big thank you to our waiters Jesus and Antonio for making our night so special!!

Fantastic atmosphere. Feels like a family. Food is great (highly recommend the Iberian feather and the cava/lemon sorbet). The photos do not capture the flavors. Looks simple but is fantastic!

PS. While reading the reviews here prior to visiting, I wondered why many mentioned names of the people working there. Now I know. Anthony, Jesus and Victor were some of the servers we had the pleasure to meet tonight. Family vibes for sure. Already looking forward to coming back!
Tuna tartar and shitaki mushrooms with sibas are the absolute must have! Galician octopus cooked to perfection. Anthony is the best, very friendly and attentive!

After all the glowing reviews from "Tripadvisor", I decided to give this place a chance and went there with my wife for a (hopefully) special Saturday meal.

Everything was perfect, from start to finish. The service we received from the whole crew was outstanding (Antonio in particular and Carlos were exceedingly attentive and kind), and the dishes, top-notch ("buñuelos de bacalao", "pulpo braseado" and "torrija" were out of this world).

And the prices are very reasonable, given what you get.

We will be back for sure!

What a great lunch !! After more than three months without been able to go out and enjoy what we considered normal or simple things , we went today to Montes de Galicia to have lunch, the service was perfect , we felt really safe , they give you an envelope to keep your mask while you eat , the food was DELICIOUS, we had Salmon Mousse as appetizer, Mixed Salad, Seafood Soup, Lubina with Szechuan pepper sauce and a great dessert. We had such a great time that I forgot to take some pics on the dishes, only for the dessert . A place to go and enjoy the new normal .

I’m a bit late in posting this review but I ate here a year ago gone May. This was by far one of the best restaurants I’ve had the pleasure of eating at. The food, the service, the ambiance. Everything was perfect. Whenever I return to Madrid, the first thing I will do would be to make a reservation!
Food was crazy good, house wine is delicious and the people were so nice! A big thanks to Anthony and Jesus who made our night unforgettable!!

We travelled out to Les Montes on a friend’s recommendation. It was a bit further from the centre than we would normally go but well worth the 15 min taxi ride.

The service was exceptional, friendly, fast, attentive and they were so knowledgeable. We heard the waiter speak at least 3 languages fluently. He made us feel very comfortable and welcome from the start.

The food matched the service… perfectly seasoned, original, but familiar. The starters were generously portioned and delicious. The mains were delicious and the dessert was amazing to share.

We would definitely give the restaurant 10/10. It is a must visit for any trip to Madrid.

Absolutely outstanding restaurant from beginning to end.

Just wow. The restaurant had a fixed price menu for its 25th anniversary with a tasting menu of their fabulous starters. The cod carpaccio really stood out. The atmosphere was fantastic.

Chef, take a bow, you deserve every compliments with your balanced menu and faultless execution.

Mario, our sincere thanks for making our stay in Madrid most memorable. What an achievement team, bravo!!!

They were clearly understaffed which may explain why the fish was served cold, and two crying babies in strollers didn’t help the ambience. That said, they knew it was a subpar experience, giving us free dessert (which had lactose…and we had chosen this restaurant because of its emphasis on gluten-free and lactose-free cuisine) and a bottle of wine. Save your euros, and eat anywhere else.

This was by far our best meal in Madrid. The food was exquisite, delicious and carefully prepared. The venue is beautiful, but beyond all this the service was the best we had ever experienced. Mario was attentive, provided us with excellent recommendations and even provided us with some extra selections. At one point during our dinner he came over and asked “did I hear you are celebrating someone’s birthday?” which we were but had not informed the restaurant. With this he handed me a birthday gift, and heartfelt birthday wishes. The food itself, Mario and the entire staff made our experience beyond wonderful, and one we will never forget. Do not miss this restaurant while in Madrid. Highly recommend!

Amazing food and service!

It was my introduction to Galician cuisine. Our waiter Alex provided amazing suggestions and service. The house offered courtesy entrees and desserts.

All the food was extremely delicious and well presented. To top it off, we were gifted courtesy wine bottles!

I will gladly return the next time I am in Madrid.
My husband and I really want to thank Eloy who provided such a considerable service,the food is great,so is the environment of the restaurant ,by the way the price is reasonable .

“Hands down, that was the best breakfast I’ve EVER had in my life.” - quote from my husband, a breakfast connoisseur and mega eggs enthusiast.

My husband’s enthusiasm was sparked by Zenith’s signature Eggs Zenith, which consists of sourdough toast, avocado, chives, hollandaise sauce, jamón ( he subbed ham) and, the real showstopper - poached breaded eggs.

How does one even go about breading poached eggs?!? It must be magic! (I can barely fry an egg without sealing havoc on my hubby’s most beloved meal). These eggs were poached to perfection, with a thin layer of fried breadcrumbs delicately enveloping the egg white. Delicious!

I had customized eggs with toast and an iced coffee. My order had a great yum factor as well.

Friendly service, excellent ambiance and amazing food. Five stars!

If I lived in Madrid this would be a regular haunt! The brunch is amazing - lots of choice, generous helpings and superb value.

The coffee is fantastic and the yoghurt with fruit, but the danger is you eat too much!
Various propositions of dishes, trendy, healthy or less reasonable ;-) staff is cool, service was quick, didn’t have to wait to long outside. Most important thing: it was very tasty. We’ll be back!

We were visiting Madrid with some friends and the second day we went to Zenit for breakfast. We hadn't booked ahead and came around 09:30 and the place was already full. But they opened additional part of the restaurant at 10:00 so we were put on the waiting list and after 30 min got a table.

We all ordered different dished. I had a sandwich with fried eggs, avocado, bacon and tomato. And me and my wife shared a chocolate yogurt bowl with granola and strawberries. Both dishes we fantastic.

To conclude I was a bit hesitant if we were to wait 30 min for the table, but I'm so glad we did. This qualifies as on of the better breakfast experiences I had. This was a perfect way to start the day and prepare for exploring Madrid.

Amazing breakfast and service!
Romana the waitress was extremely careful and sweet, toke care of everything we needed
We will come back for sure!!
This is an excellent place for a brunch. The Zenith Eggs are an absolute must. I highly recommend the place.
Wow, what a wonderful food!! And a great service of Ricardo! Will be back soon in when we return to Madrid.
Amazing food and customer service!! Best brunch ever :) Really welcoming and cute space!! The staff is beyond nice and always available to help!
It is very nice place, with amazing food and super friendly staff, Valeria is the best. You should defenitely visit the place
Great food and great service in english as well! Waiting time was not long despite it being a busy Sunday morning.
I ordered eggs Benedict and they were great. Liza was super nice to me and the food came in early so everything was more than perfect. I would definitely come back!

We were four friends from Barcelona, wishing to have an international Saturday Brunch. The whole experience was nice & smooth from the very first moment we were waiting in line outside the place, till we payed and left. A very complete menu. Good food. Variety of drinks. And a very kind staff. Special attention to be payed for Federico, our table tender, who always took care of us and never left nothing to attend.
Warming welcoming in Zenith Brunch & Cocktails. Valeria take care of us during all the time. Nice atmosphere, modern place and mostly great food ! Just everything everybody want !

We had to wait outside to go in, but after 15mins we were inside. The staff is very nice and the food is to die for ! Will definitely recommend my friends visiting Madrid to not miss this place ! A special well done goes to our waitress Valenia she was very professional and very sweet and helpful! 5 stars for me ! See you again!
Excellent breakfast. Had a lovely shakshuka and toast. Very flavoursome. Great toast to mop up all the juices. Lovely cafe.

This was the perfect choice for our brunch.
Great food, great prices, great atmosphere, our waitress was very professional and helpful as well.
Highly recommended for anyone in Madrid.

Visiting from Texas. Our daughter who lives in Madrid recommended Zenith for brunch.
Delicious! Recommend the Zenith Toast, açaí bowl and the taco trilogy.

Valeria was very efficient and sweet!

Will definitely come back!
The place is perfect. The food, the service, the atmosphere.. everything. Went there 2 times during my 4 night stay just because it was just so good.
Went with my friends for brunch and had a great time. Couldn’t recommend more - Shana served us and she was a delight!
Shana’s service was amazing!! Food was incredible and the music and ambient as well. Highly recommended and very affordable prices yet high quality food

This brunch is just amazing, I was there with two friends and we looved it. When we arrived we queued for 20 min we knew I was probably a great place and it was sooo worth it. The space is beautifully decorated and pretty big to me.
As for the service, Nana took care of our table and she was sooo nice, patient to explain us our options and of good advice (there's a great choice of meals and all look crazy good - Thank youuu Nana) ! One friend and I took the personalised option with toast and all the ingredients were fresh and very tasty (the pesto is to die for !). I think whatever you choose it'll be really good so go for it. I know that I will go back for sure when I come to Madrid during summer this time!
Regarding the price it's really affordable as we took a savory and sweet option plus a hot beverage and an homemade juice (which is a lot) and only paid 30€ each with a small tip and we did not eat for the entire day until 22pm !

Thanks again, the Zenith Brunch and cocktails is the best brunch I had in a long time !
Me and my dad came to zenith for lunch and the service was immaculate! Virginia was especially friendly and attentive! Thanks Zenith!
The food was great and the coffee as well. We were well taken care of by Valería, our server, who took our orders with a smile and made sure we were comfortable and did not miss anything.

SUCH a lovely place. The ambiance and decorations are amazing. I also LOVED our server, she was the sweetest and most attentive server, her name is Valeria. She is always with a smile cheering you up. Totally recommend visiting, especially if Valeria is serving you!

Superb service and the food was excellent. Had brunch on Sunday with Zenith eggs and smoked salmon. French toast was also delicious. I cannot recommend Zenith highly enough. Thanks to Valeria for looking after us so well. We’ll be back!

I was looking for some fresh breakfast for my last day in Madrid And I found the best place for it! The coffe had the taste that I was looking for and the cold Açai bowl was just what I needed for a fresh start to the hot day.
And to not forgot! Not just Valeria who was taking care of me and my orders but all the people in this beautiful place are making the atmosphere super friendly.

Thank you for nice morning:))
Best Regards
Anna from Czech Republic
I didn’t aspect a great experience. Food, location and stuff are amazing. Just didn’t like seats because they aren’t so much comfortable
The food was perfect and delicious. We were served by Valeria who was very friendly and pleasant. I strongly recommend the place to visit.
Nice service and good food. Nice environment and a large list of options to eat. Good coffee! Very well placed too, very centric.

Came here for brunch. The food was excellent and drinks were delicious. I would also like to mention our server Charlie, she was extremely helpful and pleasant to deal with. She accommodated us moving tables away from the air conditioning. I would 100% recommend Zenith for food and drinks in Madrid.
Fabulous food and amazing service from Charlie! Would recommend to anyone coming to Madrid! We will be back soon :)
I’m from NYC and our server Charlie gave us some of the best service I’ve ever had. Highly recommend coming here and will def come back

So we’re a bunch of picky New Yorkers/Londoners, so were slightly sceptical of a large brunch venue. But honestly this place blew us away - not only is the food great with good portion sizes and very affordable - but our server, Charlie, was unbelievably attentive and charming. One of our group had a nut allergy and she checked and double checked everything beautifully. It would be easy to imagine her working in any of the top restaurants in the world. The five stars go to her.
The food was amazing from the shakshouka to the açai such as the presentation but must of all the service of Charlie, the waiter that was more than perfect !
We had the most amazing brunch at Zenith!! The team were really warm and friendly and the food was to die for! The flavour of the shakshuka was incredible… a must visit!

Been to Zenith for 3 days in a row and tried something different each day! Service was amazing from Ariana and the food was always perfect!

We would come back again and again!
Super cute modern decor, great drinks, tons of delicious brunch options. Would be great for a girls outing. Florencia was our server and she was fantastic!

The place is well decorated and welcoming. The food is great and healthy. Gynneth served us with quality and effectiveness. I would recommend for brunch or late breakfast with friends, family or lover :).

We love coming here for some coffee brunch and chill and introducing international friends to it. The whole staff is super friendly and speaks fluent English. Delicious food as always and one of our favourite coffee shops in Madrid. 10/10 every time!

Thank you Juliette for the fantastic service!
The food is great and the service is even better! Juliette was so attentive and gave us great recommendations! Awesome spot for brunch if you’re in the Malasaña area.
Highly recommend, the food is great but the service is even better ! Thank you Juliette we had a very good time, we will definitely come back !

Hi, service was excellent we were served by Cindy, who were kind and attentive.
However, the bagel were slightly disappointing.
The food was amazing and Juliette made us feel very welcome and comfortable! Great experience, definitely recommend to try french toast :)
I had a great meal here with my brother. The food was delicious and we had amazing service! I would definitely come back here again!
We eat breakfast it was great food and nice waiters and Roos is the best she is vrey kind and smile face ❤️❤️
Great menu and perfect taste. Staffs are also nice. Price/performance ratio is extremely high. For breakfast and brunch you should go there.

You can smell the delicious food from the outside. Once you enter you are greeted and seated right away by the friendly staff. our server Cindy was amazing and her recommendation of the menus was just what we wanted. Definitely will visit again.
Gigi was fantastic! She gave great service and brunch was amazing, we will def come back if we are in Madrid again!

The service was excellent and the food to also the vibes wear over the roof
Are servant Karina was very kind and it was overall and awesome experience.
This Friday Brunch was the highlight of our trip. Best service ever done by Virginia. We recommend not only the food but also the service !!! What a way the end the week!!!

Would like to start by saying the food really was incredible, well worth it, and the choices of wine were as well. Would return on the basis of the food alone!

However, the service was unfortunately the worst in the whole of Madrid. We arrived at 8:55 for a 9pm booking and waited for 10 minutes to be served, only to be told our table still wasn't ready. No real apology was given. Took over 30 minutes to order some wine and food. Food took over 45 minutes to come. Also asking for the bill for a bit of an ordeal. Clearly very understaffed and don't seem to care about repeat custom, or making your evening special at all.

Staff were just plain rude, which was a massive shame! I know you were all busy, but there is no excuse.

We turned up here with a group of 8 on a Saturday evening at 21:30 / 9:30 pm without a booking and the fantastic crew sorted out a table for us. We pretty well ordered everything on the tapas menu and it was ok, but nothing special. I have no idea why it is rated so highly. The service was fast and efficient, but not very personal - probably had to do with the fact we had no reservation. We sat on a long table at the rear of the restaurant next to the storage room so unfortunately the staff were squeezing past all the time. If you're looking for authentic tapas, go elsewhere. If you're looking for a place to eat with a large group, for a reasonable price, try this place.

Very cute bar in the center of Madrid.
Great simple food, very reasonable prices.
Don't miss to order Gazpacho soup. It's amazing.
We had a great waiter name Jose. Very friendly, funny and ready to cater.

The Inclan Brutal bar is a fun place to grab a drink and a bite and a great launch pad for so many other places in the area. It's in a part of town where there are a lot of choices, so if you don't have a reservation, you are not out of luck.

The chic at the door (Great to meet you Frieda) was very nice and welcoming. My table-mates were 30 minutes late but she held our table. She is used to the Iberian sense of time.

In the meantime I hung out at the bar, where they do not skimp on the pours.

This is a semi-open kitchen kind of place. It has the feel of a chain from the looks of the menus, but feels more like an independent from the service.

We enjoyed some very nice Paella. It took quite some time to prepare (always a good sign). The Hummous was fantastic. I also had an excellent mojito.

The prices were very reasonable.

There are many choices for dinner in Madrid and I am sure if you make this choice you will not regret it.

First day, started with sangria, chicken, tortilla, and "don" bao. Chicken cooked perfectly, tortilla with lovely truffle oil, and the bak with spice "kick".

Second day, started with tintonde verrano, then with veal, "cloth hanged" bacon with apple bread, cheese and bacon, and huevos. Veal with hearty juice, bacon, cheese and apple cannot go wrong with a "torch show" to get that bacon going. Huevos with their style was also superb.

Food is great, but the service was better! The barman Santiago was highly attentive, suggesting waiting people to sit around at the bar to comfort them. And of course, I received good services from him despite it wad a super busy days. Muchas Gracias!

Sadly I was alone, so I could not order seafood paella, which was flying out from kitchen so many times.

Really worth a visit here to see some tapas with contemporary cooking!

Arrived to find I'd booked the wrong day but a table found for us after a few minutes wait with some drinks (missus happy with largest G&T I've seen for a while!)

Very friendly staff we were looked after by Manuel and Alex. Food not 'classic' tapas but was delicious. Portions v big we were advised by Manuel to choose only a couple of starters between us before we (4 of us) shared a steak (gorgeous, cooked rare by default) and a paella - enormous prawns, mussels, beautiful. Made a non-alcoholic monitor for my daughter and made to feel v welcome.

Would highly recommend

I went to this place on a guided tapes meal evening tour. The food here is excellent and the Paella is one of the best that I have tasted. The place was packed with Spanish locals and the queue outside confirmed that the food here is good.

Visited on a Thursday at 22:30. We were hardly acknowledged and when we finally were, we were told to wait. We then got a table and they left us waiting again leaving us with onky the menu to peruse but no offer of a drink. No one attended to us and after 10-15 min we left. The service did seem snobby with staff very concerned about their own appearance.

Had high expectations as trip advisor rated well. Decor on entering did not excite us but some of the best restaurants we have eaten in were not the most stylish . Got seated on a chair that we would probably leave for the garbage man . Waiter arrived , did not speak English but was gracious to ask his friend to take over . Not wanting sangria or beer that they tried to push on us we asked for wine list. We have , we have not. In the end more have nots. Ordered food. My wife had the burrata cheese and I ordered the gazpacho soup . The cheese came along with 2 gazpacho soup . So far great ,but wine was warm and we were advised not to drink for 10 mins. Excellent this far. Then we ordered grilled veal and chicken. Veal , was medium rare as requested but was tough and we ate half of it . The chicken was raw . The waiter seemed shocked when I cut into it and showed him. Would be replaced at no charge. It replaced but we were charged . There was a distinct shortage of menus . Ours was borrowed numerous times as were the condiments. At this stage we were ready to leave. Sorry , normally I agree with trip advisor but I would , could not recommend to my friends .

We came across the bar while we were doing a 'tapas &cañas' tour. As a big fan of Valle-Inclán's "Luces de Bohemia", the bar inmediately catch my attention. Our hostess Valentina received our group with a huge smile and immediately find us a very nice table. While waiting a couple of minutes for our drinks to arrive, we enjoy the wonderful decoration of the bar, modern, minimalist, full of life...there were eveb some pages of the author's oeuvre hanging from the wall. Yet the atmosphere was not the best thing about Inclán...the food is delicious, we were able to find even vegan options (something difficult to get when you are in Madrid surrounded by meat lovers!), the drinks were spectacular. I'd definitely recommend their 'rebujito', and the attention was top, all the waiters were kind, they are accoustumed to receive international costumers, so they do speak English and some of them French. I would definetely recommend this brutal bar :D

This bar is right near Santa Ana square and was a nice modern tapas bar. We had to wait for around 10 minutes to get a table at 9.30pm so you may want to book if you have a large group. The food was great and well priced, along with a great cocktail range.

Great people, good food, extrodinary serving.
Realy carefull and friendly employes, looking to give customers the best expearience . I definetly recomend this place .
Very nice food and friendly, enthousiast staff. We've been here 2 evenings in a row. Nacho makes you the best cocktails and the small dishes are delicious. A must visit!

Went there twice during our recent stay in Madrid. Menu is limited and it is a busy and noisy place in the heart of the entertainment district. Staff is friendly and making reservations with TA / Fork worked well. Had fantastic burrata, foie gras, and gazpacho. A decent bottle of red wine was $16. A definite recommendation.

Visited Inclan Brutal Bar for my short stay in Madrid and really loved the food! Highlights for me being the Octopus! Shout out to Christian for being such a great Waiter. Would definitely visit again when I come back to this amazing city!

We walked into this restaurant without any reservations after having heard of it from others. The friendly staff (That speaks English, big plus here in Madrid) were able to give us a table and explained to us the menu. They serve mostly small plates that you can share with others at a decent price. The taste is amazing and very delicate. I would definately go here again.

Typical Spanish food with modern style, it's a good please to hang out, eat and drink something. Paloma the girl who were out waitress was so kindly!! I'll totally return there on my next visit to Madrid!

This restaurant was recommended to us by a lady on the door at Rosi La Loca Taberna. We had hoped to eat at Rosi La Loca but it was full and Inclan is owned by the same people. We were a little unsure whether to go at first, but my goodness, how glad we were that we did!

Our table was a high table with stools in the bar area as the restaurant was full. It was fun being sat there as we got to talk to most of the waiters/waitresses. The staff are all so friendly and helpful, they make you feel very welcome.

We chose 7/8 dishes between 3 of us. This was plenty though I would have loved to have tried more as everything on the menu sounds so appetising. The stand out dishes for us were the Bao Brutal con Carne, Bavette de Ternera and Cajon de Esto No Es Tomate. Everything was absolutely delicious. We also had several mini cocktails and shared a couple of desserts. The desserts were tasty but not as interesting and exciting as the tapas and cocktails were.

This restaurant is very reasonably priced and cost less than €100 for 8/9 dishes, 2 desserts, mini cocktails, beers and a €10 tip.

I highly recommend this restaurant and can’t wait to go back there when we next visit Madrid.
Interesting menu and great paella, lovely venue, friendly staff. Well worth a visit. Advise booking as they are very busy. Evening visit did not disappoint.

Came across this restaurant after a stroll down Calle de la Huertas. The reviews absolutely match the atmosphere and the quality of the drinks and food.

We settled at the bar and were well hosted by Guillermo and Ruben, best cocktails we had in Madrid. The tapas were also unique and delicious, pairing well with the drinks. Would absolutely visit again when in Madrid.

We chose this place after reading good reviews on trip advisor. We had three courses with tapas to start, main and dessert. The food was incredible and it was like a theatrical experience made even better by the attentive staff. The mini cocktails were delicious. Really reasonable with main courses under 10 euros and a glass of wine under 3 euros. Our host Angelica spoke three languages and was brilliant. Booking is advised as it was full when we visited.
this one was best in show, on our Madrid tour, Food awesome wine really good value 3.5 euros for a big glass, and staff are really friendly, dont miss out

Our family went here on our recent trip and loved our experience! We were there on the early side, 6:00, and had great service. Our waiter spoke English, his parents even live in a town close to ours in the US. The food is imaginative and delicious. We had the burrata, hummus, octopus-which comes out in a dome of smoke, and my husband enjoyed the sardines- which come hanging on a tiny “clothesline”. If we hadn’t have wanted to try other places we would have gone back in a heartbeat for a second dinner. Cocktails were also good, as were the different sangrias. Highly recommend.

We were a group of 21 for which they had a set menu with unlimited drinks. The food and drinks were all delicious. Great value and service and a fantastic atmosphere, we had such a great time here. Worth a visit, would love to return!

Well, well, well, what can I say? A taste phenomenon! Highly recommend the gamberro chicken, was to DIE for. The most bougie establishment in this city. Not just food, was an experience. Francesco and Helena were fantastic hosts too!

This restaurant was simply fabulous. We tried to get in on Friday night but the place was full until 1130. We differ made reservations for Saturday night which was their last night in Madrid. Glad we were able to finish her last night at this restaurant. It was simply the best restaurant that we ate at in Spain. From the beet Gaspacho to the Tuna Tataki to the smoked bacalao the dinner was simply amazing. The ambience was great and the service was perfect. Our waiter Francesco was the best!! He was on top of everything quickly. This restaurant was simply
5 star everything without the white tablecloth and the expense.

Great place to eat. Usually is busy so book before your visit. we didn’t but we were lucky and there was a space for us. We have tried potatoes with brutal sauce, potatoes and ham croquettes, potatoes omelet, hot dogs, risotto and pork sirloin. Everything was just soo delicious! Highly recommend this place ☺️

We spent a great evening at Inclan. The food was superb and the service to match. Vanessa and Helena were a very charming front of house! I highly recommend Inclan to anyone looking to dive into some decent gastromy in Madrid.

Fantastic service, atmosphere and great food. Robert our waiter was very friendly and helpful. Also Francesco even walked us all the way to one of their other bars called Enbabia so we could continue our night! Would definitely recommend this place to anyone.
Tapas at its best! Innovative rendering of traditional tapas. Great service .. Alex and team treats you to a great experiene

Named after Ramón María del Valle-Inclán, the radical Galician dramatist who subverted the traditionalism of the Spanish theatrical establishment of the 20th century----there was nothing radical about the place when I visited for lunch. I suspect the ambiance changes greatly at night. However, the enthusiasm of the staff was contagious and the menu was varied, creative and well priced. I enjoyed the large portions of mushroom risotto and the cod in a coconut milk vegetable sauce. Music, other than a top forty soundtrack, would have added to the atmosphere. Overall a good experience.

A friend in the US recommended we come here. We were not disappointed! We had the croquettes, the pork loin, and the barratta cheese with pesto. AMAZING! We came in right when they opened and had great conversation with Nico, working the bar. You have to check this place out. It was by far the best Tapas we have had since being I'm Spain. Anna had great menu recommendations. Do not miss this place!

We came back from Bernabeu (0:2 !!) and wanted to have a quick lunch without reservation. After 5 minutes we had table and Rebecca was our nice waitress. The food was really good, presented in a different way (try Tiramisu and you understand!) and the wine recommendation was perfect!
A really nice location, friendly people and good food!
Go there and be happy!!
tasty and innovative tapas, great cocktails (mother of dragons), cool atmosphere and superb service (I would like to mention Guillermo).
The staff is very friendly and the food is absolutely delicious! Its a very pleasant ambient in the center of the city. Would defietly recommend for family, friends and couples.
Very close to Plaza del Sol is this Restaurant. The service of the Staff is friendly. Good wine and beer offer. Top Recommended. We try the Paells. Excellent in taste and size. Delicious.

We just dropped by for a lunch while walking in the tourist tracks between Puerta del Sol and Santa Ana. We got tropical salad, tune fish, chicken and octopus. All were delicious and beautifully presented. The portrait on the wall made us learn a little about Spanish drama. A delightful experience.

입장부터 매우 친절했고 영어메뉴도 제공해줬어요.
The best staff George He was humourous, kind and so nice to us.
한국에서 왔다니까 한국출신 dj도 소개시켜줬구요ㅋㅋ
간단한 스페인어도 알려줬답니당! George 덕분에 마드리드가 더 좋아졌어요:)
먹물빠에야, 이베리코 크로켓, 이베리코서로인,샹그리아, 스프라이트를 시켰는데 음식이 전부 다 맛있었어요. 다만 저희는 유럽에 오래 머무르는 중이라 입맛에 맞았는데 한국에서 바로 오신 분들께는 빠에야가 좀 짜게 느껴질수있어용. Less salt 할거냐고도 물어봐주니까 기호에 맞게 주문하시면 됩니다. 샹그리아가 red, pink, white 세가지가 있어서 특이했고 저희는 pink를 마셨는데 맛있었습니다.
그리고 먹물빠에야는 정말 맛있었지만 입술과 치아에 까만먹물이..묻어서..조심하셔야합니다ㅋㅋ 물티슈를 제공해주시긴 해요!
분위기도 너무 좋구 가게도 이쁘구 참 좋은 기억으로 남았습니다. 셀카도 정말 잘나와요!ㅋㅋ 마드리드에 짧게 머무는게 아쉬웠어요
And Gracias George. You are the Best

We went to the brutal bar after a recommendation from our friends. We didn’t know what to expect because the restaurant does not have the most typical dishes but it’s much much better than that. Every dish we ordered surprised us even more. My favorite was the shrimp dish in a kind of shell. The taste from the fish/meat with combination of the different kind of sauces are so nice. I would really recommend this place but make a reservation before because it’s very populair. We were very lucky to have seats even when we didn’t make a reservation they did everything to help us get a seat. There drinks are also very good and they have a lot of different kinds of cocktails which are very tasty. I think they even invented some of them their selfs. I think this whole restaurant is very impressive the food the service and the whole atmosphere. Especially because the restaurant is placed in a street which you wouldn’t usually. My credits go to the enthusiasm of our waiter Nico he was very happy en friendly en got us even take a desert (which we didn’t regret). I hope you guys are lucky as well to get served by nico even if I think al the other waiters were very friendly en hardworking as well. And last the prices are very good especially if you think of the value for money you will get. Thank you brutal bar I will come back for sure and hopefully many more times.
Had a great experience here. Nice food on a nice location. Manu was giving a lot of excellent tips about the food and Laura was really sweet. Would come back here!

We left the restaurant with full tummies and happy memories. Ate couple of tapas and full size meat dish with two of us. It was more than enough. Stuff is sincerelly friendly. They look also happy to be part of their team. Manu(our ober) was helpful, not disturbing and always there when you need something. Thank you:)

We ended our trip with this restaurent and Oh GOD was it goood!

The atmosphere is very cozy and modern,and you know that saying "we eat with our eyes" well at INCLAN you will eat with every sense you have; the food is very tasty and well presented our waiter Nico is just the BEST;he recommended for desert to have cheese cacke and it was by far the best I ever tasted.
We will definetly recommend this place to every one we know !!!

My husband and I were lucky enough to get a table without a reservation, but this place is worth any advance planning necessary. Every cocktail and meal course was creative, beautiful and a joy to taste. Service was friendly, helpful and welcoming. Our servers Jose and Manu were exceptional. I will be dreaming about the scallops with lime. Other notable items The Mother of Dragons Cocktail, Ay!! Macarena cocktail and another not yet on the menu with passion fruit and peanuts, and the bacon cheesecake. The vibe of the place is modern and hip. We have a few nights left and will return. The prices are very reasonable as well.

We had a wonderful time for diner with friends in this restaurant. The food is excellent and really worth the price. We really appreciated the 2 waiters Manu and George who were in charge of our table. Nice place and we highly recommend it

We went with a huge group of girls with a great atmosphere! Drinks were great and funky with the burrata as appetizers. Such a fun chill place and great hidden spot in Madrid. Luis was a fantastic waiter

Me and my friend Arthur from Brazil were walking through Madrid and looking for some nice place to have a drink and then we saw this lovely and fancy bar called Inclan Brutal Bar the staff was so nice with us starting with Laura the hostess, then Natalia, Carlos and Jose. We had tried some nice drinks made for Guillermo (the lovely barman). Everything was perfect! Congrats, guys! You rock!
good place to eat and drink cocktails, the attention from the reception to the waiters especially Stefano and Guillermo with a gift for creating the best cocktails 10/10

Cocktails were incredible and we recommend you to take the bourrata and the tortillas con truffles!
Thank you Jose L for the service
Had a wonderful time here! The atmosphere was very cool, the drinks were delicious, and Bryan provided amazing service!! Will be coming back soon :)

I went here for drinks and ordered the Joker cocktail. The drink was good but pretty small and a little overpriced at 13 euros- I guess you are paying for the atmosphere. We were sat at the bar near the front window and it was pretty uncomfortable. The service was also a little slow and you need to flag down the waiters to get served or get the check. In my opinion, this place was overhyped, but my experience may have been better if we were seated somewhere else. Good place for pictures, but not worth it for me.

Not a lot to look at, from outside, but pretty, authentic and welcoming inside. We found it simply by chance as we were waiting to get into our apartment next door. Friendly staff and traditional. Originally downstairs was an "airing room" for the Iberian Hams, but now it is a lovely cellar restaurant. One night we had a lovely steak and another night "Tapas" upstairs in a relaxing bar. All the food was very good. Staff were excellent. Very reasonably priced wine list...but not the Vega de Sicilia !!! Great selection of Hams including the best 5J... they also run the butchers nearby, so they know their stuff. Highly recommended.

The restaurant has a extraordinary atmosphere and is situated near the Royal Palace. The waiter was very keen for us to have a nice evening. He had a lot of interesting things to say bout the food, which was original and excellent. Just one thing - don't trust him if he says the 2 person portion can be eaten by oneself ;-)

Based on the other excellent reviews, I was really looking forward to my meal at La Mi Venta, which was just a short walk from my hotel.

It was not particularly busy when I arrived as it was quite early and I choose an outside table, which had a partial view of the lovely Palace. I had already looked at the menu on the internet and had picked out the Entrecote steak. Perhaps it was just an off day, but unfortunately the meat was a bit on the chewy side and although asking for rare, it was also cooked closer to medium rare - this was fine though. The accompanying potatoes with green peppers was very nice, but the main part of the meal as mentioned was just average compared to many other restaurants I have visited charging similar rates (about 20 Euros).

The service was attentive and I could not fault that aspect. This may be Spanish related, but the annoying thing was that some bread and olive oil had been brought to my table when I arrived. I assumed that this was complementary, as it is still at many restaurants, but upon checking the bill I was charged for this without being asked if I wanted it. I did not query this at is was just less than 2 Euros and I had had a long day and did not want to get into an argument. If there are extras, then a restaurant should really make this clear if they are to be charged though.

I would like to give it a second chance if I returned, but with so many other good restaurants to choose from, I will likely not be returning.

This was our first stop during a recent visit to Madrid. Our host, a Madrid native, introduced us and we weren't disappointed. The atmosphere was charming, the service was excellent and the food was amazing. Everyone raved about the Iberian ham which was slow roasted and so succulent. I ordered hake cheeks...tender fish, seasoned perfectly. We drank the house rioja which was excellent. Highly recommended!

Don't hesitate: book this restaurant now before it's too late!

Very good restaurant, excellent price/value ratio: food is excellent, meat of a quality you don't find much anymore & for a fair price.

David as host did a very nice job: friendly and with a lot of passion + clear explanation of the menu. Same goes for Jose which takes good care of you as guest.

Nice ambiance: cosy and intimate.

We were searching for this restaurant, since we saw a number of great reviews on tripadvisor. A lot of them were talking about the great service and we hesitated a bit, since we had some problems with the serrvice in Madrid.

However, this time things were different. The waiter could speak English and he was VERY helpful with recommendations and with his smile and polite attitude. He even put our phones/tablets on a chair and covered them with at towel that he was carrying with him, so that nobody could see them!

The food was good, the place was great (we ate outside), the price was okay for a place like this.

Excellent choice for us and recommended for everybody.

We'd had lunch there three days ago and liked it very much so decided to go there for our final dinner in Madrid. Guillermo was our waiter and he gave us excellent recommendations for our meal, shared baby goat and a superb Mauro red to accompany.
Excellent food and service, we'll recommend to any friends coming to Madrid.

As the title already says - we were impressed! Especially, by the service. It was the first time I was in Spain and I had never eaten a paella at that time, so my girlfriend and I walked into that friendly-looking restaurant. The waiter was not only good, he was really passionate! I can quote him saying: "If you really want the rice, I can give you the rice, but that's not what we are known for. Other places make better rice, but we are amongst the best in terms of meat.". And that's when we decided that we will eat Paella another day. We had a patanegra pork steak with a ratatouille as side dish and it was incredible. Also, they made sure that our wine glasses were never empty and that we are always served with hot bread and fresh olive oil.
If I ever visit Madrid again, La mi Venta is a must.

Picked this restaurant based on the stellar reviews. Requested a table in 'the cave'. Fantastic ambiance, great gin drinks, good jamon, but what set this place apart for me was the main course. I opted for the steak, which was over-the-top good. My wife had the pork loin. Now mind you, I've had good pork loin in the past, but I was NOT prepared for the amazing flavor and texture of the meat that arrived at our table. This was BY FAR, the best meal I've EVER had in my 55 years. Roberto our waiter was attentive and polite. Highly recommended!!!

Very impressive place, great tapas but the meat was far from expected.
The deserts looks delicious, looks like a fun place to sit outside for a coffee and desert.

Very nice service and tasty foods.
We had a nive time with my girlfriend.
Good enterior.
Everything was excellent.
Try tito de verano. :)

I had read some reviews on here and my group of five were keen for a Paella. You must go down stairs where is it very cosy and comfortable and you can get out of the Madrid heat.
Enrique our waiter was excellent and very attentive to detail and provided any answers in English re the menu. I shared a cold meat entree which was the best I have had all trip. The others had the tuna which they enjoyed. We enjoyed some local beers and. Local sweet wine. The main course we shared the mixed paella which was simply divine for a seafood lover. This is a must try in Madrid. Loved this restaurant so would recommend. Our bill for 5 came to Eur 114 so not to bad.

Booked for outside - place filled up really quickly. Just had tapas and our favourite was the foie gras and apple compote. In fact ordered a second helping. And the pricing is reasonable. Well worth a visit!

Excellent service and great choice of food and wine. Waiter who served us was very friendly and helpful. We had a table in what looks to have been a former cured ham cellar and was very atmospheric. I can highly recommend the Acorn Fed 100% Iberian "Secreto" Cut and the Lamb chop (be aware the lamb chops are quite small though), the Chocolate Mousse with Almond Crisp and Pistachio Ice Cream was absolutely gorgeous......a lovely bottle of wine (MARQUÉS DE RISCAL) accompanied the food. All this for a very reasonable price. If I'm ever back in Madrid I'll be back. Highly recommended.
The food was excellent and the service was incredible. The staff was incredibly attentive. The wine selection was amazing and very well priced. The atmosphere was lovely and quaint. Highly recommend.
Great food, great service..we did our Trip Advisor research before booking and are so glad we did as this family restaurant delivered on all counts. Thanks

This restaurant is a hidden gem near the palace. From arriving we were made to feel welcome and we're seated in the 'cave' area (pre book this online to avoid disappointment). The staff were brilliant and explained the menu options available and provided wine recommendations. The food was superb and not too expensive. The setting was really special and a restaurant I will never forget. We loved the olive oil and bread with our starters. You have to try this place!

Our friend found this by chance online because it is near our hotel. Our server was Jose and the service he provided was 5-star all the way. Enrique was also by helpful and very nice. They were both warm and personable, and provided excellent recommendations during our meal. We started with the appetizer (bandeja imperial) with several different types of AMAZING Spanish ham. Also we ordered an organic tomato salad that was fantastic. We had grilled meats and fish for our entrees. Wonderdul desserts, too. Have the brownie! It's not a brownie in the typical American style but wow is it delicious. The wines are mostly Spanish, very good and quite inexpensive.

Visited on a Sunday night, booked in the afternoon but would probably have still got in. Ate downstairs in the old butcher house. Great host who explained everything to us and made some recommendations based on what we told him we like. Had some of the famous olive oil they serve (wife preferred it to me, it was quite an intense flavour). Great seafood paella accompanied by a nice bottle of white wine.
Lovely restaurant with lots of character, and characters!

Although Spaniards typically eat a late dinner (9pm and later) we came anyways because of the reviews! We only had tapas because we could not stay up that late enough (the kitchen opens at 8) but they were wonderful! Our server, Enrique, was so helpful and patient and the tapas were delicious! It was fun to try some traditional Spanish dishes! I would definitely suggest coming here at dinner. It is a fun location!

This is definitely the best of the best restaurants I have been to.

The decor and style of the restaurant is very original, with plenty of charm. When we arrived, we were seated straight away after reserving a table (it was packed so I would definitely reserve beforehand).

The service provided was excellent, very friendly and good members of staff were able to help talking through the menu in English (which is a skill in itself) but also make recommendations on the food.

When the food arrived (very efficiently and quickly) it was amazing. The corn fed loin, the croquettes, the Iberian ham and the tapas of pinchos were absolutely delicious. We also had a bottle of wine, kindly recommended by a member of staff and overall it was a really good experience with really good food.

Would definitely return and recommend to anyone wanting to try some quality food at a very good price!

I went in that restaurant after a deep check of TripAdvisor and Google reviews. So the meat is good, I took roasted pork with green peppers and potatoes, typical Spanish dish.
Good, but not like I was expecting.
The wine is not served properly. If you want just a glass or two, they serve wines that are opened since a while and it badly affect the taste of the wine.
Service is excellent and local pretty good.
Price is a little bit expensive compared on other restaurants in Madrid center.

It was our last night in Madrid and after having been to another restaurant with possibly the best steak I ever had, I had high expectations. Extremely popular place and very small dining room so you must make a reservation (which we did). The people in front of us walked in and were turned away. Lovely dining room downstairs in the cellar. Impeccable service. Very attentive wait staff. Bread was lovely and my husband enjoyed his appetizer. But the main courses were average. My husbands steak was ok. My lamb chops were bland and had very little meat on them. My apple turnover dessert was delicious, but I had such high hopes for this meal I was quite disappointed.

What a gem of a restaurant. My friend and I both had the tapas. The waiter suggested we add a tomato dish, which complemented our mains perfectly.
The staff were friendly and we had a great laugh with them. A must visit.

The gin/tonic is not just great, but worth the serving experience (try it), the t-bone meat, the service and the atmosphere makes this a hidden gem. Spot on top notch quality. I might live a year shorter due to that perfect grilled red meat, but it was all worth it!

We had a beautiful meal in this restaurant. Wecordered the Paella for 2 and were informed that we would wait 40 mins. For the meal. However, the staff were very friendly and provided tapas and as promised the meal arrived at expected time and well worth the wait. Very friendly staff

I'm from Canada and I know what how to recognize a good service. In Spain, people are not so frendly and the service is not the best...

But THERE! Wow. Miguel, our waiter, was really nice. He know the rules of service, he was cool and able to give us some recomandations.

This is a perfect mix of quality and good price!
Had a great time there. They are really nice and also offering a great service. The seabass was great , the lamb chops a bit fatty but we enjoyed the whole experience.

It's hard to add anything on the previous reviews but, just to say, I took my mother here for a special meal on Sunday 28th January and it was our highlight of the trip.

The restaurant doesn't open until 8.00pm so if you arrive early, you might be welcomed with a 'ham soup' .... but don't worry, the evening gets better and better.

The Cave is the place to eat so, if available, request this. The menu, the service, the ambience.....everything is OUTSTANDING. Check the website out for the full menu but I would highly recommend the tapas to start and the entrecote steak of cod as a main. Gin and tonic sorbet to finish is unbelievable.

Waiting staff are faultless, the wine list is incredible, location is beautiful. really have nothing negative to say about this wonderful restaurant.

The food and service here was fantastic. Among three of us, we shared the T-Bone steak (highly recommend and feeds two) and one of the specials. I most definitely recommend sticking with meat dishes (not because the other dishes weren't as good, but because the meat was that spectacular). Given the quality of food, this is a price performer when compared to restaurants in the US of this quality.

The ambience is very quaint, and get a table in the basement. It makes you feel like you're eating in an old wine cellar. I will definitely be returning!

We arrived 30min before opening (8pm) but they offered a place at the bar while waiting. There are not many tables, but the setting is very romantic and the food was delicious! The staff was very kind. When in Madrid you should really visit this lovely restaurant.

We longed for paella and found this place but didn’t have a reservation so we had to wait a little. In the meantime, we were offered complimentary drinks and consomé. The place was nice and the food delicious!! The service was fantastic, and our waitresses Yovani and Silvia where all the time attentive to every detail. Definitely a place to come back to!!!

A lot of food! We had the traditional tapas followed by t bone. Miguel was professional and friendly with sensible advice. Excellent service, a real pro!! We sat outside with a view of the palace (a corner of it!) Steak was great (though maybe a little fatty) potatoes and padron peppers were amazing. Couple next door to us described their dinner as the best they’d had in Spain. We were only visiting a couple of days but we thought the same.
We had their special tapas plate and their charcoal grilled iberian pork. Well done but nothing out of this world. The waiter was very attentive and we enjoyed the service. Overall grade B.
Just 2 min walk away from the very touristic area you’ll find this amazing place. Food and service is the best that we found in Madrid and if Didier is serving you, it’s even better.
The food was exquisite and the service was even better - particularly Juan who was so helpful, polite and charming. I would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone going to Madrid.

Visited this evening for a meal before leaving Madrid the next day. The staff were so knowledgeable and attentive. The service and environment was excellent. We started off withe the cured meat and cheese tapas absolutely delicious. We followed this with the steak which was cooked to perfection. Portions were just the right size. That said we had no room for dessert. Definitely recommend.

La Mi Venta is for us the perfect spanish restaurant for a night out in Madrid. It really has the whole picture. Specially the waiter Juan is a big part of all that. We will continue having a good time there every time we visit Madrid.
The best place to eat on this side of the city. The food was superb and my waiter, Didier, was the nicest and most attentive waiter I've had in Spain. Cannot recommend enough.

Book early to get an inside table. But if you get there by 8pm or a little afterm, you could snag an outside table, whcih is what we did. The weather was perfect for this.

Our two waiters (Juan was one) were very helpful and energetic.

We started with coktails - Mojito for my partner, Bombay Gin tonic for me.

For dinner, she had Chuletitas de Lechal a l.a Parrilla de Carbón, and I got the Entrecote de Lomo de Vaca a la Parrilla de Carbón. The baby lamb chops were very tiny but quite tasty. The steak was VERY good!

Shared dessert was a chocolate mousse, very delicate and smooth.

We had a lovely time

We had our best meal in Madrid in this restaurant! Fantastic food, beautiful atmosphere and the most friendly service! The restaurant is owned by 5 brothers and we met the oldest brother who was “on duty” that evening whom we had a great chat with. The evening was so enjoyable and we felt like we have been invited into their home - every single staff was so friendly and loved to chat (even if they weren’t serving us). We were going to have a light meal but ended up doing a three course meal - everything was so fresh and tasty, even the olive oil (so we had to ask for more bread although we had planned to opt out of bread)... what a great experience on our last night in Madrid! This restaurant is highly recommended if you are after great food, atmosphere and company :) we wish to be back again already.

We stopped at this restaurant one afternoon after a trip to the cathedral and the palace. They were able to seat us even though they were very busy. We had a table downstairs in the basement, an old wine cellar or ham hanging area, which we thought was charming. We had a variety plate of their excellent hams. My husband had the “entrecot steak” which he really liked. The grilled chilies were very good also. The steak was perfectly cooked to his request. I had a salad with goat cheese that was also very good. My husband had the “sorbete de gin” which was gluten free and dairy free. He really enjoyed the dessert. Aitor and Ramses were our waiters and they were very attentive and friendly. Highly recommended.
Fabulous service and food was delicious. Aitor our waiter was wonderful - have booked in for tomorrow night again already!

We had lunch there and it was so nice we went back next day for dinner. Food is absolutely fantastic. Staff is very welcoming and helpful. Thank you particularly to Jazmin who was the most lovely waitress we've ever had. We will definitely go back...don't change anything guys...

We chose to have dinner at this restaurant, which was just a short walk from Gran Via after reading some good reviews. We arrived quite early at 8pm without any reservations and were given a table in the basement area that looked like a cave. We were quite hungry and just ordered the oxtail stew and truffled hamburgers. They brought out some complimentary staters of manchego cheese which were good. The burgers were nicely cooked, while the oxtail stew was tasty as well. We also ordered the sorbet and chocolate brownie for dessert which were also good. Overall, it was a pleasant experience with a good service from the waiter.

This hits my top 3 dinners ever list. Ramon recommended us to get the jamon bellota for an appetizer, my husband the iberico secreto, and myself the grilled squid. I’m so glad we listened to his recommendations. This will be a dinner for the memory books. Thanks Ramon!

We went here for lunch and were not disappointed. The seafood Paella was awesome and the service we received from Juan was exceptional.
We also ordered the combo Tapas plate while waiting for the Paella. The sausage from hell and calamari were good but the stew and veges were nothing great.
We also ordered a bottle of their house red which was 100 % tempernio. Loved it.
Above all the service from Juan was excellent

Very nice restaurant with very nice staff
We had some starters and paella which was very good
Very nice atmosphere and the price is very reasonable for the food and the location

A must visit restaurant in Madrid

The food was stunning. 3 of us had steak and one had pork. We all thought it was absolutely delicious. The steak was beautifully cooked and melted in my mouth. The gentleman that served us, who I believe was the manager, was so nice and attentive. We really enjoyed eating here.

Had a lovely meal at this restaurant last week. Quality and quantity of the food was very good and the restaurant has a nice and unique atmosphere. Service by jose and vincent was amazing, thanks to them! Always someone ready to take our order or attent to our needs.

We booked a table at La Barraca for our first Friday night in Madrid. It was fairly full when we arrived and a waitress checked our reservation and promptly sent us downstairs - I don't especially have a problem with sitting downstairs to eat but I do resent being sent downstairs to eat with all the other tourists and the locals are allowed to stay upstairs. It really made us feel very uncomfortable - like second class citizens. I used to live in Madrid and speak fluent spanish so I asked a waiter why we'd been sat in the basement and he said they always put tourists downstairs. Charming! The food was also slightly disappointing, quite salty and very saffrony but the chicken and fish etc was nicely cooked. Quite pricey for a paella so wou;dn't recommend it.

I've known this restaurant for about twenty years and it continues to be one of the best in Madrid to eat paella or one of the many other rice dishes typical of the Valencia region. Service is great, the food is invariably between fine and great. You can't go wrong with this choice. The only doubt - you sometimes get the feeling they're becoming just a little complacent.....

Although we enjoyed the paella at La Baracca, I think this restaurant can do much better. Especially on the level of service and price value. Our paella was tasty but - as mentioned in other reviews - a bit undercooked for my taste. More disturbing was the lack of proper service and staff. Our waitress tried to make the best of it, but all the time she got directed to other tables by her snippy boss. I wouldn't return to this restaurant next time I'm in Madrid.

La Barraca came highly recommended by a friend. We really searched it out as we wanted to have excellent paella. Based on the TripAdvisor reviews, I ordered the Paella Valenciana and some bacalao. The bacalao was disappointing because there was more batter than actual bacalao, I'm not kidding. You can have much better bacalao in tapas bars. And the Paella was just ok. It wasn't bad but I don't understand why this place would be so popular. The Ali-oli was very good though. And the restaurant wasn't too cheap either.

I had the most delicious, creamy, fragrant paella in this restaurant. I requested a paella with shrimps and chicken. I will always remember it and will go back to this restaurant if I go to Madrid again. I also tried their garlic shrimp (FANTASTIC) and their garlic sauce is the best in the world! The staff was very friendly and attentive. (April 2012)

We had the cod fritters and mushroom starters, and they were quite ordinary, and the mushrooms underseasoned. For mains we shared the house seafood paella, and it was very tasty. Service wise, while we did arrive late, after eleven, we did feel a bit rushed out of the place.
Been here two times. Food is fantastic..restaurant is cozy and service is great. I think it must be a bit touristy but its good..it's expensive but worth it. Any paella dish is great here.

Enjoy a paella, made according to Spanish tradition, at this nice, cosy and intimate restaurang. The service is friendly and the staff attentive. A table reservation is recommended, as the restaurant is quite popular.
The paella is incredibly dry and over priced. You're better off eating at a McDonald's than this place. Complete tourist trap.

If you love la paella this is The SPOT to enjoy it in Madrid
We tried others but nothing came close to la Barraca
Our son has been in Madrid for over 3 months and he agrees this is the best yet!
Service was Great and appetizers were fantastic..... Olives and cheese of course along with tomatoe and tuna salad
Esta bien

The paella was nicely done, with only one tiny dislike which was the sugar snap peas in one of them -- they were overcooked and mushy. The service was excellent, the wine delicious, and be sure to save room for dessert.

It is hard to say, there must be hundreds of pealla restaurants in Madrid, most of them geared towards tourists.

Madrid is not the best place for this rice dish, I have had much better in Valencia, where it originated. I have been disappointed many times in Madrid with restaurants that claim to have good paella, but then it is too far below par to even consider going back.

Paella when well made is delicious and when badly made...its just a plate of boring rice.

This restaurant has good paella, which doesn't seem to be easy. The place is frequented by locals, which is a good sign.

The starters are all very nice (careful, paella is filling!) and the paella assortment is broad. I have of course not tried all of them but the 2 kinds I have tried were delicious, savoury and wholesome.

Decoration is nice, service is polite and very professional. The prices are very reasonable, I did not drink any wine and did not even look at the menu card.

Just off Gran Via it is in a very lively area with lots of night places around. If you are visiting Spain and you are not going to go to Valencia and want to try a good paella go to this place, you will not be disappointed.

In this restaurant you will eat genuine Paella, be with meat Paella, mixed, seafood or any of the other fine options they have. We ate a mixed Paella (2 px min) but we saw plenty of other types of Paellas passing by and they looked so good. The chicken was great, tender and the rice was so tasty.
However, come with time, because this is not a place to come and expect to be eating in minutes. The first time we went to this restaurant it was already full, so we booked for the next day.

On Sunday the 28th of september we went to la barraca with a confirmed reservation in both Spanish and English. The american couple who arrived a couple of minutes before us was rudely sent away, because the "manager" could not find their reservation...
And there was not a single table available what so ever...because of a large touristgroup...Our visit to the best paella restaurant of Madrid was because of the special occasion of my 50th Birthday, a present from my sister who made the reservation more than a month before. We also were sent away because the manager couln't find our reservation.What a shame....they prefer serving large tourist groups and overbook single party's. Asked for an explanation by mail....no excuses at all!

When you consider the full package this restaurant offers -- superb Paella, a warm, comfortable and inviting setting and excellent service -- I simply have to rate La Barraca as my favorite restaurant in Madrid. The costs can shoot up the more you order, so if you are like me and come here for the Paella, restrain yourself and stick to that. You will be pleased with the meal and with the bill.

We were spending a couple of days in Madrid, before heading back to the States, after vacationing with friends in their town in Spain. We wanted paella for dinner one night but couldn't decide where to go. Our friends, who are Spanish and whose family we we're visiting while in Spain, kept saying that in all the years they have been traveling back and forth from the States to Spain they have never had a good paella. I convinced them to try La Barraca. I'm glad I did and they were also. It was the best paella I have ever had. We tried the traditional, seafood and rabbit. Each one was better then the last. Our friends were in amazement!! They kept saying how good it was and after all these years they have finally found a restaurant in Spain that actually has traditional paella. Everything we ate that night including our appetizers were great. Even our kids, who can be picky at times ate everything. If you go you won't be sorry and if you go, don't forget to have the sangria!!!!

Without a reservation got a table to a lovely restaurant. Very tasty paella. We left very satisfied with a really traditional Spanish experience. Would definitely recommend and go again. The Waiter experience, even though he couldn't speak great English, was really helpful and made our visit welcoming :)

I celebrated my 50th birthday at La Barraca. As there were 28 people attending, they provided a set menu, which they let me create myself from their menu. They also catered for 2 people who did not eat meat or seafood, and made a vegetarian paella. They also allowed three people to have meat dishes from the main menu (not rice). The service was excellent with an astonishing amount of food, beer and wine flowing, all from the set menu price. They also very kindly came out with candles on a cake, which I had not expected. An excellent way to have celebrated my birthday!

Probably you heard before about Paellas or even you tried one before. You also have to know that thera a lot of types of Paellas that almost everybody have their own one. Paellas and rice are cook with diferent ingredients and, as a result of this, the flavour might be diferent. In La Barraca you can find deveral types of Paella and diferent types of Rice. (Don´t get confused, Paella and Rice is not the same).
