La Barraca used to be an excellent restaurant, in my opinion it is still good but not as good as it was years ago. Even though I recomend you to go there but be conscious of the tupe of Paella or Rice that you order.
If you are in madrid and you want to eat the most traditional Spanish plate you must come here and order paella and take advices from Dimas
The restaurant is clean, nice atmosphere, the waters are very helpful. The starter was good, main course was fantastic, La Reina Paella!

Waited 10 minutes at the door, but not a single waiter took the liberty to attend to us.

Went in to ask a waiter, who told us to wait for a moment. Apparently a moment means waiting another 20 minutes, after which we were told that the restaurant was fully booked, which is something they could have told us right from the start.

Definitely the worst service I have ever experienced! Highly recommend if you would like to experience the worst service in your life.

I've been here three times in as many years and have never been disappointed. Great service, great location and best of all: great food. I guess that some of the negative reviews were probably due to the fact that this is a fairly upscale place so if you show up in a dirty t-shirt, baseball cap and flip-flops you may raise a few eyebrows and may not get the best service. As in most upscale restaurants you'd better reserve ahead.

As is common with many other viewers, we were recommended this place by our hotel reception. Booking was easy, and when we arrived the waiting staff were very attentive and the gin and tonic was spectacular! They were very nice to the kids too which was a bonus. Then it started filling up quickly. And every single table was tourists. Not necessarily bad but generally a poor sign. The service became patchy and the food was nothing to write home about. The fried Crayfish were clearly frozen and the shellfish on the Queen Paella we ordered didn't seem all that fresh. Desserts were good. All in all a pleasant evening and it was not that expensive (150 for 4 with a bottle of wine) but we wont be going again.

We decided to visit this restaurant having read the many fantastic reviews and was not left disappointed. We initially wanted lunch here but unfortunately they were fully booked so we booked to have dinner there the same day. We ordered the mixed seafood paella and it was superb. Pact full of flavour and lots of sea food ingredients. The service was also exceptional, very helpful manager and waiter. A definate must try!

This place was recommended by a good friend / foodie and it did meet our expectations. The Seafood paella we shared was certainly one of the best we ever had. Rice was cooked perfectly, Seafood was tasty and the service was very efficient. We did not try anything else on the menu but glad that we sampled some tasty Paella... Highly Recommended!

When we inquired about a good restaurant for paella, our hotel suggested La Barraca, one block north of Gran Via. It turned out to be an excellent choice. We shared the paella with chicken and rabbit, but there are a number of other paella choices on the menu, as well as other non-paella dishes. We also shared a carafe of the house wine, which was very good.
It was recommended to us by the bellhop at the Westin Hotel. We loved it, although we can't really compare it to other paellerias.
Have been thee three times and has always been delicious. Order the seafood paella! It has two big shrimp on top and is full of seafood.

As far as paella in Madrid goes, this is pretty good. Good size portion and a reasonable price.
When visitors come and they ask for a good paella, I often send them here.

We chose this place because we wanted to eat paella and this place has a big selection on the menu. This is a large restaurant, and seems to be popular with tourists. However the paella was great, the apply pie was delicious, and together with a bottle of wine way too much for two people! We left holding our bellies.

quality of the paella is good, not too big portion, but the one with fish I had was not too dry (as you can find sometimes) and fish was sufficient in quantity and very good in quality. the price is about 25 € with a simple wine. the place is ok, nothing fancy, and the service is attentive.

Delicious Paella and great atmosphere. Do not go without reservation. We are visiting Barraca at our every Madrid travel
Be careful, do not confuse Barraca the another Restaurants are in the same street

Nine o'clock dinners are too late. We opted for 3:45 big late lunches. Had steak the first day and traditional paella the second. What a treat after a week of tapas and pintxes.
Service is excellent, house wine good and reasonable.
A must if staying in centro.

We ordered a salad to share for the starter, 9 euros for some iceberg salad with two pieces of preserved asparagus, it had no flavour, no texture... a total failure! The "famous paella", had no taste at all and was overpriced. One of our worst culinary (I don't event know if I want to use this word to describe it) experience in our Spanish trip. To avoid absolutely!

La Barraca is a well known paella restaurant in Madrid but the service was non-existent. The waiters and waitresses wouldn't even make eye contact with us and we waited for almost 10 mins just to get black pepper. The Spanish omelette and paella were quite delicious though, except for the fact that the chicken was overcooked and dried like a rubber...I would say it's a bit overpriced.
Staff was brilliant, food was delicious, definitely recomment the paella, seafood is fresh. Our daughter had the veal for the children menu and she absolutely loved it.

The staff were nice and professional. We ordered the famous traditional paella and it was great as expected based on earlier reviews. Otherwise we Liked the atmosphere. Time to food was also reasonable. Overall great restaurant and definitely a must try.

It’s an elegant restaurant with classical food service. They are famous by their savory paella dishes. We had try tripe stew as well and it was delicious. (and taste-wise very close to Hungarian way of cooking and seasoning tripe stew, so we enjoyed so much) . We recommend to taste their homemade sangria served chilled in a huge pitcher. Better if you reserve your table in advance.

We went to dinner here on the basis of the good reviews we have read. While the setting was very pleasant, the decor very nice and the staff very attentive, we found that the food was not great. We chose the chicken and rabbit paella and were surprised that it didn’t come with any accompaniments. It was difficult to differentiate the chicken from the rabbit. In any case most of the meat was very boney. There was little else in the rice apart from a few beans. It was not up to the standard of other paella that we have had. We would suggest that a salad or other vegetables be offered to accompany the main course. When asked if we would like water with our meal we said we preferred tap water but they brought bottled water which we asked to be returned. Desserts were completely unremarkable.

Have to be honest here, although I’ve never been a fan of a paella I decided when in Spain maybe it might taste different. It was ok, maybe I’m just not a paella kinda person, the rest of the group seemed to like it a lot, have to agree with other reviews as to not having enough seafood but I guess that’s just their recipe,
Service was good setting nice
Would I go again probably not
Madrid is not famous for it's paella, but this place is the very top in the city! Casual atmosphere, simple menú, great taste! Book in advance.

We went for lunch because I was craving Paella. You have to split the paella with another person so we ordered a non seafood paella (my partner doesn’t like seafood) and it was still very tasty. Reasonable drink prices as well. The service was the best we’ve experienced since we have been in Spain and the decor is very charming. I would highly recommend La Barraca!

Hotels of Madrid please stop recommending this restaurant to gullible tourists - I was one of many from Japan, Italy etc, It may have been good once but surely its best days are behind it. The supposed Valencian superlative cuisine sold to us was nowhere to be seen. Cold starters, obviously overly refrigerated were followed by one of the worst paella’s (the restaurant speciality) I’ve had the misfortune to taste. ‘Lobster’ was actually langoustine, so dry and what little
Meat there was, so difficult to prise from the shell. The rice was moist but overly salted - in a nutshell lazy, shoddy food packaged in an ‘authentic’ style. Staff were friendly enough and we did leave a tip - the so disappointing food was not their fault and they seemed adequately embarrassed about our complaints though no chef or management explanation was forthcoming. A lesson sadly learnt - hotels and curious guests please take note.

Arrived here on a whim for a late lunch and were lucky to get a table just before the kitchen closed. Seated straight away and ordered the mixed seafood paella and a just of Sangria.

Sangria took a little while to arrive but we were in no rush so didn't mind, while waiting we were offered bread & alioli which we agreed to. Paella arrived and was amazing, huge portions, large selection of fresh seafood it was great.

Sangria was fresh and tasty, we had about 3 glasses each so well worth the 17 Euro charge.

Service was great, professional and friendly without being intrusive. We had a great meal but just to give you a heads up the Bread/Alioli we weer offered we were charged 5 Euro for which is fine but was not expected as we were not informed in the first place. So just a word of warning! Bill for Bread/Alioli, Paella & Sangria was 50 Euro. Paella is charged per portion rather than the dish, we thought 15 euro was reasonable.

Great place, recommended!

The food from starters to the Mixed Paella were absolutely great! This is a very nice restaurant which will not blow your budget at all. The wait staff was very nice and accommodating. it is a very well lit establishment with nice decor. For three grown adults, we certainly left full and happy.

This is a good place to go for paella. We have returned multiple times and will return again. The food is good and the servers are very pleasant. It is an attractive restaurant not far from the Gran Via.
The mixed paella was really good! The atmosphere was chill, would like some more music. The service was nice :)

We were looking so forward to our paella dinner. From the moment we arrived the women who "greeted" us seemed annoyed we were there. We had a 10 pm reservation,
which is not late in Madrid. And there we time slots available after ours. This woman was further annoyed when we asked questions about the menu. After we had paid for our expensive dinner, we asked for a group photo. Again she was annoyed. And then.....as we were waiting for our taxis they literally told us we had to get out. When I said it was raining she said there was a little hang over. It was not big enough to keep us dry. Can you imagine being kicked out of a suppossedly fancy restaurant in the rain when your cab is on the way! No food is worth that. Stay away!!

We were in Madrid for five days and mainly chose to eat informally at some of the excellent tapas places in the city. This was our one evening out in a “proper” restaurant, and we made the most of a large, shared paella for three! It’s a relatively informal and friendly place with good service and decently priced drinks, do it’s worth seeking out.

The main advantage of Oven is that it serves food in the afternoon and early evening for travelers who may be too hungry to wait until 8:30pm when most Spanish restaurants open. But to be fair, my pizza was hot and cheesy while the beer was cheap. I left content and not too broke.
A very nice pizza place. The oven burata was very tasty and the pizza was equally as good. The service was exceptional. Very good value for money. I would definitely recommend it.

We came here based on the great trip advisor reviews. The appearance was great and we loved the decor. The staff basically ignored us upon arrival and the service was just awful. The only redeeming thing was that the pizza was excellent. This place could be a 5 star restaurant if better managed. Really a shame.
Ate here on the first night in Gran Via, it's was a lovely place, had a nice atmosphere and the food was great. The staff were helpful and very attentive.
Great restaurant that my wife and I come to a lot. Great service there and the food is always good. I recommend the pera y trufa pizza and the delmonte salad.
Good location, good food, good prices, and great service. My family particularly appreciated Ana, who was very informative, attentive and showed personal interest in our travels.
Loved it, excellent food, service is not bad but it could be faster, a great choice if you like to discover new things, nice decorations.
This is a lovely restaurant with great food and wine at really reasonable prices. Staff very nice also. Always very busy so be prepared to wait.

Went here on our first night after a long day. It was quiet but we were a little early at 7pm. Most dont seem to start to fet busy until at least 8pm. The place is central on the gran via. The waiters were polite and helpfull. We had salads to start followed by spaghetti vongole and lasagna. Everything was fine, but they could have waited untilwe had finished our salads before bringing the mains. All in all reasonably priced.A few more vongole would also help. It was quite busy by the time we left and pizzasnseemed very popular

Equivalent of a good pizza chain in U.K. Reasonable prices. Service slow as not enough staff. Decor is great but toilets need to be checked more regularly. No toilet paper/paper towels. Close to Puerta del Sol.
I really liked the pizza here! Service was good too! I highly recommend it! Try the one with peach or pear in it!

This restaurant met all of our criteria when dining out. Excellent food. Nice ambience. Attentive service. And fantastic value. We ordered two ceviches which were delicious. Two types of pizzas both perfect and delicious. Two bolognes pasta dishes which had perfect balance of meat to pasta and delicious flavors, pasta perfectly cooked. My daughter ate the mushroom pasta with truffles also delicious. Authentic flavors.
We had excellent service with attention the entire night. Definitely a restaurant I would recommend and go back to again in a heartbeat.
Good pizza, service and wine menu in a central location. Very contemporary restaurant and made for very pleasant meal. Plenty of other things to choose from on menu too.

Had a spicy pizza, lovely pasta and beers. Must visit the scenic washroom. Very unusual. After gorging at the Mercado san Miguel in the morning decided to hace sit down meal. Location on Gran Via was also near our hotel.
The food was great, the pizzas are one of the best in Madrid, the pasta is also good. One problem was that there was a big group upstairs so they said we had to wait and the kids were really hungry

We were here in Madrid on a mini break and craving a pasta dish on our last night after all the tapas and paella we had eaten

We both had a mozzarella starter and agreed that it was the best mozzarella we had tasted

I had the lobster ravioli and my partner had the beef ravioli which was lovely and we both finished with the tiramisu which was divine

Overall a lovely restaurant with fab staff and reasonable prices for a capital city.

Would definately recommend
We came to the restaurant by a recommended we love the food and Good food and the service was great by antoneu.

Came here for a family meal. We had a spaghetti carbonara and penne calabrese. Both were fantastic. Portions were plenty and was made quite quickly. For drinks we had a bottle of red wine, whilst the wine was on the cheaper side, it was still a delight. Our waiter recommended the biscotti for dessert and I absolutely understood why.

If you're in Madrid, visit this place. You will not regret it.

Food was average, was not tasty, service was bad.
The waiter acted as if he was being forced to work.

Nice restaurant in Gran Vía. Food was great, service was perfect and the place is lovely! I really liked the decorations, it's a very nice place to have a romantic dinner. Of course the food was amazing! Their speciality is cheese and italian food I think. We tried a pizza and some pasta and everything was awesome! Would recommend it!
Nice cosmopolitan restaurant to eat good Italian food. You should reserve a table because the place is quite full, notably on the weekend.
Super! Tasty! Perfect service. High quality of food ingredients. We like this place and want recommend it. Burrata is amazing

Amazing food for sure, but severely lacking in service. It was not self seating, but I had to go find somebody within the restaurant to let them know we were there, and after finding somebody finally a different server yelled at me for blocking the walk way. After getting our table we waited 15 minutes before we got up and got our own menus. Then after another 10 finally somebody came to our table for our order! We then got our food pretty quickly. Although when we got our pizza the server took our appetizer plates and said she would bring us new ones (same lady who had yelled at me). We ended up eating without plates as she never returned. Promptly after finishing our food then cleared our table and took our empty glasses, and then we waited nearly 30 minutes for our check. By far this was the worse service we had in our 2 week trip to Spain.
We arrived in Madrid and stumbled upon oven when the restaurant we tried was closed. We were so thankful for the delicious meal
I went to Mozarella Oven in Gran Via an had a tremendous culinary experience. Probably, the best pizza that I have ever eaten. The service was unique which was provided by Manuela and Jennifer.

Such a great place ! The food is simply delicious , the meals are in good portions and most important the service is amazing ! Thanks to Valentina our great waitres we had great experience in this place !
Excellent service and nice, quiet place to to converse with friends. I tried two of their facilities and both had the same consistent service .
Very good food! We order pasta and pizza its was very tasty and the prices are good. The dissert with the cookie was excellent !

Are you hungry and craving some pizza?
We were walking back to our hotel and we decided to stop by Oven Mozzarella Bar in Gran Via.
It looked pretty cool and elegant from outside.
We noticed that it was really hard to get a table, it looked that there was quite a long wait.
We were lucky: weird enough, some tables were cleaned in a matter of 5 minutes and we were comfortably seated.
Our table was very close to the kitchen so it was fun to watch the pizza men doing their lovely job....it was like a beautiful show.
We ordered pizza margherita, chicken pizza, spicy prawn linguine, and salmon in hollandaise sauce with baked potatoes.
The pizza were crunchy and good, but they...forgot to add tomato sauce. What kind of Margherita pizza was that, without red tomatoes sauce?
For dessert we had apple crumble cake and affogato di caffe' (an Italian coffee-based dessert which takes the form of a scoop of vanilla gelato "drowned" with a shot of hot espresso).
Everything was pretty tasty.
We had a problem with the waiter: in taking our orders, he forgot to write down "the timing" of what we wanted. The result was that the pizzas and main courses came to our table all together...and we had to send back the pasta and the salmon for later. For that reason, when the spiced linguine returned, they were cold and over-cooked.
Certainly the place is beautiful, elegant, spacious, clean with a lovey and stylish
décor. It was a nice surprice to find out at second floor a gigantic portrait of a smiling Rita Hayworth on the brick wall and, next to the restrooms, three charming Greek-style amphorae as washbasins, with a bright-red neon sign 'bacio' (kiss).
Reasonable prices. Service must be tutored.
Recommended

Decided to try an Italian for a change after eating a few meals in local Spanish restaurants.

Picked this one mainly based on the reviews and it certainly did not disappoint. Will highly recommend the Mediterranean burrata. Their Pizzas ans pastas are all freshly made and super delicious.

Superb value for money and will certainly return here.

Please be aware that the restaurant can get extremely busy in the evenings and would recommend to reserve if possible.

Had a lovely dinner at Oven. The restaurant is beautiful and is situated on a lively street. Efrain was very kind and helpful with the menu. We had the salmon and mozzarella salad, the rigatoni 4 formaggi and a margherita pizza which were all terrific.

I visited multiple times Oven in January and the one in Gran Via had good food but very bad service, so I preferred going to Oven Atocha. However, today I went and the service was great, very polite and fast. A waiter called Daniel served me with other too colleges. I tried pizza with mortadella and it was fantastic. I tried Gnocchi and I didn’t like them, but they have the BEST tiramisu in whole Madrid. Also, before I used to eat very often tagliatelle with truffles and they are my favorite.

The restaurant is very beautiful, nice to sit there.
The dishes i took there were pizza and cannelloni - the cannelloni was awesome never tried something like this very recommended dish. Also the tiramisu is delicious.
But it took a long time to take the order from us.

After eating Jamon and tapaps and rice for 10 days we were ready for some good old pizza. Our hotel recommended we try Oven and we were not disappointed. Great appitizers and fantastic pizza, Service was exceptional. Every person in that restaurant is working extremely hard to make sure you have the best experiece possible. John Viodeta and Jesus made us feel very welcome and like they really cared that we had a great experience. They did not rest the entire time we were there. Top notch!!! So good we came back the next night for a repeat.

We booked this restaurant via Tripadvisor during a recent stay. When we arrived at 7pm the table was not ready and we were asked to wait outside which wasn't the best start. After a 5-10 min wait we were shown to our table. Here on in the service was great. We ordered the bread basket to start and 2 pizzas and a pasta dish to follow. The bread was delicious and the pizzas very tasty and perfectly baked. The restaurant itself is over 2 floors, is modern and has a nice feel to it.

Interesting place where they give some twists to italian classics. I had a combination of burrata with iberico ham. We ordered pasta and it was ok. Dessert was a millefoglie with pastry cream and dulce de leche. Good/fast service and reasonable price

We ate at the famous Oven restaurant, not the first time here but still its get better each time! The food is amazing, fresh, hand made and delicious! And another important and not so obvious is the service. Everyone of the employees are so welcoming and nice and especially i most compliment Jesus for being so kind and helpful. Dont miss this place!
This place was amazing. I love the service it was amazing and the food was great. My servicer Lisseth was spectacular.

I went to have some food and drinks there and was surprised by the quality of the ambience of the place.
The girl who served me was Michelle, she was lovely and made my experience TOP. Definitely ask for her when you go there.
I recommend it 100%.

Our waiter this visit was Jesus! He was so delightful and informative! He recommended us the best plates! Truly everything here is amazing! Remember to ask for Jesus when you come! You’ll be guaranteed the best service and recommendations!
The food was great! We had the truffle burrata, truffle pasta and pizza margherita. Everything was delicious. Also great service by Carlos. We will definitely come back on our next visit in Madrid!!
We had a lovely evening at this restaurant. We were served by Melek and Naima they helped us with translating and gave us all the time and space we needed. We loved it!

Was looking for a good Italian restaurant in Madrid near my hotel and this certainly did the job. Made a reservation for 8:00 but this would not have been necessary, it was not very busy at this time and it was also a large restaurant. Start out with a tinto de verano, which comes in a very generously sized glass. Expect a large menu to choose from (I had the pasta with pesto and shrimp and it was delicious, one of the best pesto sauces I’ve had), satisfying portions, and overall fresh Italian in the heart of Spain! Also a great spot for comfortable solo dining- very comfortable seating and atmosphere in general. My waiter Jesús made the experience even better! Very patient, attentive, and accommodating to someone that doesn’t speak Spanish as their first language but it still trying to practice. Would definitely return and try pizza, it looked wonderful!
Excellent and very efficient service by Axel. The food was delicious! We definitely recommend this place and will come back soon.
The service was very good. The girl was so kind and made delicious lemonade’s. The pasta pesto is a 10/10! Definitely recommend coming to this restaurant!
Great food. Ordered the truffle pappardelle with mushrooms which was great. For dessert the biscotti was delicious. Service from Deyli was really great!

We had Diavola and Prosciutto funghi pizzas.
Nice crispy crust and acceptable ingredients.
Tarta cremosa de queso was good and well presented.

The meals were served quickly.
The staff was friendly and helpful.
The place looks clean and tidy.

I recommend it.

Mediocare food, staff who don’t speak English.
Staff were pleasant enough though, comfortable sitting.

We had the pepperoni pizza which was ok but not great and the mozzarella caprese which was awful.
Very good food, we were here with a group. Would definitely recommend!!! Very good pizza and risotto. De bediening was ook tiptop in orde.

Very respectful and very good service
Best food ever.
Thank u so much i really enjoyed
❤️
Can’t describe the taste of the pasta

We were tired from a full day of exploring and decided to pop into this restaurant for a pizza and salad. It's safe to say that our expectations were completely exceeded. We got a table by the window and enjoyed the people watching and the salad & wine. We asked for the pizza to be "cocinando mucho" and they obliged (which isn't the case everywhere). It came just the way we like it and was delicious. Good prices too. We're planning to come back!

We took a break from tapas during our recent Madrid visit and loved the thin crust pizza from Oven Mozzerela. The crust, sauce, and toppings were perfect! Servers were very friendly. Reasonable wine prices too! Tiramisu was a great way to finish the meal! Restaurant is in a busy area for great people watching. Highly recommend!

Very good Italian restaurant in the most commercial street of Madrid : fuencarral. The service is perfect, very nice and efficient. The value for money is excellent and all products are fresh.
Very recommendable in couple, in family or with friends!

Dont miss to order the baked eggplant it is soo yummy, and the salads are amazing,, pizza is a classic italian pizza with the pan made, and the pasta is also great,, i think the desert looks yummy but we are too full to order more

My wife had a real urge for Italian food on our last night in Madrid, and since my number 1 choice was booked I obliged and took her here after some research.

I gotta say, I was thoroughly impressed. The food was amazing. Pizza dough and sauce were delicious, their pasta bolognese was also very delicious, and their deep dish biscotti for dessert was a great way to end the meal.

We chose this place as it was within a half km of where we were staying.

It's an Italian restaurant with a high turnover. Think fast food.

They don't take reservations. The place was very busy when we arrived but only waited 5 mins for our table.

We ordered the Gambas ravioli and a bacon and ham pizza.

Pizza was good and so too was the ravioli, though there was hardly any shrimp in the dish.

A couple of glasses of wine and bottle of water. 30euro.

Not great value.

Meh. I wouldn't come back.
The food was very good, very good prices for the centre of Madrid, the staff were polite and very helpful

This has got to be the best best BEST pizza I have ever eaten! The staff spoke enough English to understand you. When we were given a Spanish menu we asked for an English version and the waiter was more than happy to help. Not too far from the metro station and quite reasonably priced. Could not fault the place what so ever! Very happy customer and would recommend a visit to anyone! Well worth going!

The wood fired pizza oven makes an excellent pizza. We split one as a late snack. The staff were courteous and their English was excellent. There is a good selection on the menu and the quality of the food is good. Clean and easy to get to.

Love this Italian restaurant. The food is tasty and good.
The pizza is wonderful the prices is reasonable. The services is great. I found one at Gran Via and one in another place.
Defenetly will come back.

This bar provides amazing pastas and pizzas, first class menu with decent prices. We came first time on Saturday night where the restaurant was very busy with the amount of guests coming. Served by Carlos, who was very nicely and patiently explaining all varieties in the menu. He recommended biscotti for the dessert and things could have not been better! We came again two days after, and found the same amazing experience. Will definitely visit for the third time if we came back to Madrid!

I could have eaten here every night we were in Madrid! Perfect Italian dinner for families - GREAT pizza!! All of the food was done perfectly and we loved everything about this place. The wait staff was wonderfully attentive as well. Make sure you go upstairs and check out the restrooms, too! Overall experience is a 5 out of 5!! Love this place.
This place is a nice little pizza place with a date or q group of friends. The staff are friendly and the price for the food is inexpensive. The pizza was nicely cooked and had decent flavor.

I ordered a Burrata which was really good and a margherita pizza which was also good. The dessert that I ordered though, the chocolate fondant, was incredible!! Really really good!
The service was great! We were helped by Carlos, which was able to advise us on what to order and was really friendly!

Actually ate here twice during the week. First visit was just a quick lunch - we were hungry, and it smelled pretty good. Shared the melted eggplant and tomato pan and a very fresh salad, and were perfectly happy. Service was friendly (owner serving us?) and competent. Later in the week, we needed a quick and early dinner and decided to revisit for pizza. Once again, very good and authentic tastes. Note that it was much busier at dinner, and wait staff were all young people - very friendly and pleasant, fine for this type of dining, nothing fancy.

I can give you 5 reasons why you should visit this place:
1. Amazing Italian kitchen with a great choice of different mozzarellas and burratas (about 5-10 positions in the menu)
2. Friendly and fast service
3. Delicious and beautiful cocktails
4. Very stylish and cozy interior
5. Reasonable prices
Definitely must-visit!

My partner and I visited Oven Mozzarella Bar on Gran Via two days in a role. The food was AMAZING ! The drinks were AWESOME ! The staff were well trained and friendly, especially Rai. She provided us with extremely good service. Two big thumbs up
This restaurant is located near the tribunal metro station and their service is excelent. Pizzas are very well cooked in a wooden oven, and calzones also are good. Service is excelent
The lasagne was incredibly small and it had no meat in it? For such a small meal , it was quite expensive
Stated and shared the goat cheese with wonderful balsamic vinegar. I had delicious burrata with Iberian ham and hubby had spicy pizza. Very yummy.

We went to this restaurant because we were so pleased with our earlier visit in Murcia in this chain!
We ordered the Lasagne as we did in Murcia, and know that we like!
The taste was good, but the rest of the visit was a big NO NO...
Service Was bad, and they looked like they didn't want to be there, and not interested in the costumer..
And a nother was making a terrible noise with cutlery.
We was planning on ordering more after the meal but only wanted to leave when we had eaten!
And was waiting for so long to get to pay, that I had to stand up to get the atención of the waiter. (a nother cuple did the same)
Not going back!!

Eating alone in a foreign city is always difficult especially if you are a vegetarian with very little local language. I almost walked past this place as I had not seen it before when i was in Madrid last October but the English menu and the choice and quality of food made me very pleased I gave it a try.

very good food and excellent service from our waiter Carlos!

Nice vibe and Good drinks

the pizzzas are great and salads are fresh

Luckily this place was a 5 minute walk from our apartment and what a find! Lovely service (Mercedes served us and she was particularly lovely), amazing food and great vibes! This place was also full and we timed it perfectly for a table! Definitely a must go
Great location too. Right around corner from Rena Sophia museum. Our group had 7 different dishes and all of them were well received.
Thank you Carlos for treating us great... and for the free shots We had great vegetarian pizzas with truffle, honey, egg and other exciting ingrediants. Positive staff and smiles all around!
Delicious pizza, unique flavors. We had a delicious lunch. 2 of us shared a salad and carbonara pizza. Staff was very nice and attentive.

The quality of food and service was very good.
The price could be a little bit lower.
The row material portion must be increase.

Food is great and nice cozy place. The servings are big and can be shared by two person.

What I love about Oven is their dessert. I had the salted caramel cake and it was delicious!

Will definitely go back to eat there again!

On our first night in the city we came to this restaurant for valentines dinner. Food was lovely! We and my partner both had pasta dishes, one with pepperoni tomato onion and cheese, and the other mushroom and truffle!

Good value for money and would highly recommend

My family and I really wanted some Italian food after a week of tapas. It was Perfect here. Great pizza straight from wood burning stove. Pasta was delicious. Great ambience and location. Very courteous servers.
good starter, great pizza. even better staff. would happily go there again if I am ever in Madrid. I would recommend this place to everyone if they go to Madrid.

Great italian restaurant, great service, clean, and great food.
We went to eat there twice in five days.
The desserts are good also.

We’ve been in this restaurant in the evening for dinner and it was great! Our waiter, Bautista was very kind and professional and gave us good recommendations! The food was great and the prices very comfortable. If u are there look for Bautista and enjoy.

The food was amazing ! The place itself is very modern and the atmosphere was great
highly recommended this place!

We've been there twice. This place is amazing. We really enjoyed the food and the service. Oscar served us and he was so nice and kind, he is the best!!!! :) And all the staff were great too. Very recommended

I visited Madrid with 3 girlfriends. We went to oven for lunch one day and were very satisfied. The food was great!! Additionally, we speak little Spanish and our server FRANCISCO was WONDERFUL! He was very patient and helped us to figure out what to order. He even gave suggestions of things to do in Madrid. We would definitely go back as this is a trendy spot with tasty food and wonderful service!!
Open all day. Pizza was excellent. Server David excellent In the heart of Malasaña shopping district. Nice respite and ate dinner early.

Lovely place, good atmosphere and interesting menu. Additional service could have been a little faster, after we got our meals and asked for pepper, more wine etc. Got seated very quickly even without reservation although it was busy. Nice bar to wait at.

This was one of the nicest places we dined at on holiday. We ordered the provoleta (melted cheese) starter and a selection of breads to share. Main courses were pasta served with an unusual combination of ham, tomato and pear with blue cheese for myself and braised beef ravioli for my husband. The service and food was very efficient. The food tasted great and was fresh. We skipped desert as the meal had been very filling.
Went to eat here as we saw the sign that says oven baked pizza. Great choice coming here. The food was really good. Daniel the camarero was real attentive. Thank you.
So nice to find a great and reasonable place for dinner. Thoughts of my Mom's cooking came to my mind. Our waitress Mercedes was very sweet and nice, a big plus to an evening of fine dining.

Nice atmosphere and has a bar upstairs you can wait at and have a drink. The pizza Margherita was delicious and perfectly cooked. We had the half order of bread and there was plenty and tasty. Efrain our waiter was friendly and attentive.
Very good! Highly recommended.best pizza and pasta ever.Enjoyed the evening with my husband to the full will surely come again

The food is as amazing as the waitress Mercedes.

We had business dinner and everything was great, they found a place even though we had no reservation.
Wonderful evening at Oven Mozarella Bar. The vegetarian pizza was incredible. Amazing treatment by the staff. Robert was great. I recommend.
Fantastic pizza and great ambience. Great service from Robert. Great mix of Spanish and Italian fusion. A must return to place.
We had a great dinner. The place and the food were excelente. The waiter Robert was lovely, very supportive. He made my kids and me feel like at home. Thank you Robert!

Very good! Try the margaritas, they are very good!
Than you Maria for the experience and the good vibes !
Great, cozy place to go out with friends and have fun while enjoying a tasty meal made of fresh ingredients in the center of Madrid.

I was in Madrid with my collegues, and the hotel consierge suggested to go to his favourite meat restaurant. We went quite late there, around 10.30. Not late for Spain. The service was very fast, kind and efficient. The meat was really really good!! Cooked at the right point. Well grilled. Very good also the french fries that seemed fresh and home made.
Not so much dessert, but it is fine. The only is the envinment not so much argentinian. Nice, cosy, but with weak decorations. I recommend to go and try!! the meat really worths!!

Went twice to this place over the space of four days which should tell you something. Personally, the chorizo beats the morcilla but the speciality - bife lomo bajo - was great both nights and my partner also loved the tenderloin in Roquefort sauce. The melquior crianza is excellent value at 15.50€. The bread at 1.70€ per piece is an unnecessary rip-off.

We have been received by a very unpleasant waitress.
The food is good. Pls note that starters are big enough for a couple persons.
The Steak was great.
But I won't get back there... During all dinner and everytime she came to our tabel, not smiled one time, Very rude!! She sould be advised by the managment.

We asked our stakes to be cooked medium. One got medium stake and one raw. We told about this and the waiter took the stake and brought the same stake back in few minutes, It was still raw and I told the waiter about it again. The same stake was cooked three times. In the end the stake was still raw but it was burned from the outside. All my potatoes and vegetables were cold. And we had to pay the whole price without discounts etc.

A classy but relaxed restaurant feel. Beautiful steak!
Watch the chunky meat sear on the grill from outside.
Probably not the cheapest in Madrid but well worth the money in my opinion.

We chose this restaurant for my Birthday dinner (we did not tell them that). We booked and we're glad we did as when we arrived our table was the only free one and others were trying to get in. Don't be afraid to phone if you don't speak Spanish as they do speak English. The staff were friendly, helpful, attentive and efficient. My Hubby had the provolone to start, we both had the beef tenderloin with pepper sauce and I finished with the pancake with dulce de leche. Everything was really excellent and I did not see anyone not seeming to enjoy their meals. Tables were filled again as soon as people left, but we didn't feel hurried. It isn't cheap, but you get what you pay for and for Madrid prices for good dining, it was about the going rate. We would definitely go again if we went back to Madrid.

We have not long returned from Madrid. I chose this restaurant due to the great reviews on Trip Advisor. My favourite meal is steak with pepper sauce and have had this a lot in various restaurants. Have to say my steak here was gorgeous and my husband enjoyed his meal too. Cooked to perfection, sauce lovely, staff and service excellent. Would have gone back again if we had more time in Madrid.
Best Argentine restaurant in Madrid! A must go to! Make sure to order the empanda! You wont bedisappointed. The steaks here are very tender and great quality meat!
You can't fault this place. Staff friendly and attentive. Food fantastic. Delicious steak. Centrally located. Will definitely return on our next visit the Madrid.
Excellent food quality, friendly service, loft style interior. A great alternative to the tapas place all around. Reserve a table on the weekend or after 9 pm.

A Tripadvisor search pulled up La Cabana as one of the better options for eating close to our hotel. We called to reserve a table, they told us they were fully booked but to stop by and they would see if they could fit us in. From the moment we walked in, we knew we found a gem of a place. Service was great from the beginning, till we left. We had a short wait at the bar until a table became available. It was worth it! The food was phenomenal! Two of the best steaks I have tasted in a long time, cooked to perfection for both of us. A great wine to accompany the meal. Dessert fantastic too! I can't rate this place highly enough and wish we hadn't found it on our last night. Not the cheapest option around, but we left very happy with what we paid. I would recommend booking a table, as seats were not empty for long through the entire course of our meal.

We truly enjoyed our last meal in Madrid and last meal on our 2 week trip here. The spinach canneloni were delicious and very filling. We both enjoyed the Solomillo. Nice ambiance and in a great neighborhood. Good service, will be back!!!

My son and I ordered strip and rib eye steaks. Fantastic!, the only thing we did not enjoy so much were the veggies but who cares, steaks were great. Bill was not expensive considering this is madrid's best steak restaurant. Reservations suggested.
A fine dining experience in central Madrid. Great steaks. Every thing on the menu is ala carte and thus, very expensive. Service was very good. Wait staff was attentive, but not oppressive.

Me and my wife were hunting around at the last minute to eat on the 30th of December, just before the Pre-Uvas, Then we found La Cabana, The meat on display in the front window done it for me. Now that may sound funny but the chef is cooking on an authentic grill in the window, one look and we were in like Flynn!
We didn't have a booking and the place was busy, they said no problem and by the way the staff were super friendly. We actually are fluent in Spanish, but they insisted in speaking to us in perfect English. Whilst we waited we had a glass of wine at the bar and then shown our table. I had the steak and my wife the pork, both were fantastic and done to how we like it. The waitress actually took the time to explain how the meat would be cooked and how we would like it. The wine was Argentinian as well and normally in Spain it's well Spanish so this was great to try something new again.
Highly, highly recommended. Great service, great value. will return!!

We throughly enjoyed a variety of steak cuts! The steaks were tender juicy, and very tasty! The garlic french fries were delicious too. Along with a pitcher of sangria -made for a perfect meal. The prices were excellent, much more affordable than in the states. Highly recommend!

Quite an incredible experience eating here. We had to book but it was worth it. The steaks are huge but melt in the mouth. The chimichurri sauce with them is divine and leaves you with a heady garlic taste with the real sense of great quality Argentinian Angus. The baked potatoes were lovely too with a sumptuous herb butter and olives. A real treat and with a couple of beers ended up as €65 for 2 (wife had ribeye). She's not a big steak eater but absolutely loved it.

There are not enough adjectives to describe how wonderful their food was! So good we visited twice during our brief stay. Seasoned olives to start, bread with herb-infused olive oil, gorgeous, lean steaks that melt in your mouth, flavorful salads and veg. Sangria is fab too!

Although we hadn't booked a table and they were very busy they managed to find us a place and didn't rush for us to finish. We have eaten at various Argentine Steak Houses all over Europe and this one was the best.
The steaks were cooked perfectly and the 3 side dishes of baked potato, red peppers and parsley chips were all well seasoned and large enough to share.
The staff were very friendly and were happy to give us more flavoured olive oil (which was delicious) to have with our complimentary olives and warm bread.

Great place for Meat-lovers. You get good steak, sausage and other grilled meat at very good price. Wine list has very affordable Agentinian and Spanish wine. Glass of wine is also really good and cheap (highly recommend so you can try different kinds). If you are two, try mixed meat dish as you can variety of meat in huge portion. Pasta was Ok but not memorable.. Octopus is great. Bread is about 1 euro per person so you might ask not to get one as you will be so full from meat and sides.

Its self explanatory why this restaurant is full most of the time. Its great Argentine cuisine, wine, and friendly service, makes it a reservations required restaurant in Madrid. I showed up without one and was lucky to get the table in the bar area in the front of the restaurant. Everything was good. The Ribeye excellent. The Olive appetizers delicious. And the Caprese salad very nice with a pesto glaze added. Jaime, my server, was friendly and made sure everything was done with courtesy. Bravo!

Very nice place to have a good steak, if you get a chance try sausages! We were lucky to get a last minute reservation, the restaurant is jam packed, and the staff was excellent to accommodate us! Very nice atmosphere, attentive staff and excellent food. Olive oil dip for the bread is delicious!
We had the solomillo and it was very good. The service was excellent and the place is beautiful. A little expensive but it’s worth it.

We were there for a birthday dinner for one of my friends and everything went well. The service was good and I ordered solomillo medium- rare that was just perfect. As starter had melted cheese (cant remember the name is spanish) and it was delicious. Its little bit expensive place

Walked by this restaurant with a grill in the window just before going to the airport with a full stomach was tempted then but thought better of it put it on my bucket list. Came back on my own had a table at the back of the restaurant was served a delicious delicious steak watched the world go by left happy and feeling on to of the world. Lived up to my every expectation.
just a walking distance from our hotel ... made a booking prior. was a lovely steak superb, melts in my mouth!!! worth the money ... thanks for making our anniversary a one to remember ...

We booked for a family before coming and there was no surprises. We ordered mix grill for two persons, grill vegetables, grill chicken and cheese from the oven. We asked the waiter to remove sausages from the mix grill order and she was happy to do that. When the order arrived to the table, it was there and when we asked her why she offered no explanation. We did not have much time to argue and we let it go. The stake was delicious and offered with great and professional service from staff. Money was the restaurant is very expensive and is in need to adjust their menu to accommodate more healthy and less fatty food options.

Amazing Argentinian food and a must try when you are in town. I would recommend having any of their meat dishes. The appetizers were delicious as well. Food came fast and service was great. Not too expensive for the quality. Make sure to make reservations as they are usually fully booked.

I ordered the rib eye 500g (bigger portion) and it was more than enough with my appetizers. No need for sides when eating a steak that big. They ask you if you want to split the steak to make it thinner so it doesnt bleed as much but since I asked for it medium-well, I kept it as is and was bloody enough (more like a medium in the middle).

We actually ate here twice during our recent visit to Madrid. We found the service, food and wine as advertised. We had 2 salads, when 1 would have sufficed. My wife had a fillet and I had a cut that resembled a hangar steak. I order mine medium rare and they obviously have a different definition of what that is. You should order medium well to get it medium rare. The meats were very tasty so was the side of potatoes. The wine list is extensive, but has many moderately priced.

We went back a second time and with the beef it of our prior experience ordered properly.
For meat lovers this restaurant is a must. We had delicious, tender rib eye. Side dishes - fries, vegetables - also very good. Service friendly. Argentinian vin overpriced. Very nice ambience.
Nice interior, friendly service, ok food. A place to go for meat lovers, but I suggest to go to the bullfighters square for an amazing steak.

Excellent atmosphere, good food, waiters with really good service.
I'm sure I'll be back at least a few more times
Ambience is nice. Picana was delicious. Milanesa was awful. They charge you for the water and for the bread you didn’t even asked for. The service is not there for the price you are paying.
Really good food. Sausage and rib eye were the best. You should ask them to take a break between the starter and main..

This was the only place we found open sunday at midnight and what a great surprise. The food was excellent and so was the service. Must have steak and the soup. Good change of flavor after all the Spanish food.

Recommended by a Spanish colleague. The beef here is among the best I’ve ever had. And I’m a steakhouse kind of girl. I would caution Americans to discuss their temperature preference with the staff - I typically order medium-rare, and after my discussion ordered a medium. Very glad I did! My meat was perfect for me - but leaning more toward the rare side of an American medium rare.

Definitely try the appetizers. Sweetbreads are a specialty and they were amazing. Also got some delicious beef tartare, roasted red peppers and a crock of meaty provolone cheese.

Definitely try this place!

My partner is a meat lover and after much searching, I was able to find this beautiful restaurant.
Andres the waiter was spectacular with us, and according to my partner, he ate the best Solomillo of his life.

I ate chicken and its preparation was optimal.

I will like to point out that, in our reservation was specified that it was for a Bday celebration, and unfortunately the restaurant did not do any detail for my partner, which is the first time, usually in other places they offer a dessert or even a simple "Happy birthday".

They have to have better follow up on those of the "Special occasions" as Customer Service.

But as for the product, service price, I thought it was right, as we ordered a bottle of wine, a salad to share (they are quite nice) a Burrata with Pomodorini very good, and Empanada Argentina, he ate the Solomillo and I chicken with a garnish of vegetables (enough for 2) and an Argentinian brownie ... oh and bread.

The attentive service, the atmosphere of a very quiet place and the food quite good.

Is a place to visit and if we are in Madrid again, we will go.
Steak is amazing. Highly recommend the ribeye 300gm or the beef tenderloin 200gm. The service is good and plenty of great wines to select from.

Had a wonderful meal here last year and came back to check if it was still the same. Well, the steak solomillo was absolutely excellent again. The brownie, however, wasn't as good as we remembered it. A very nice meal anyway!

We didn’t book but it was busy so would recommend booking, we all had such gorgeous steak (melt in mouth)! Service was really good and the restaurant was modern and clean! 10/10 for food would definitely recommend like it was to us!

Spent a few days in Madrid and went here for dinner. Excellent choice as the whole evening was superb. Food was great service was even better. The whole experience was without fault and would highly recommend.

Great food, great atmosphere, we were a group of 6 friends, and liked it very much.
the prices are fair
wow, for me it was very nice experience. the place is atmospheric and nice, calming music and tasty food. ive took a bread and a salads

The quality of the meat was excellent however the meat could arrive warmer to the table. The staff is very kind although service can be slow. Very spacious restaurant which is perfect in Covid. We will come back.
Great restaurant, great food, amazing service and the decoration is really nice! I loved it and I will be back :)

We arrived early night (about 8 p.m) and by the time we left, the restaurant was packed mostly by Argentinian, which speaks for itself. We order a mix of meats and salad to share and off course desserts. We ordered a delicious sangria and had a wonderful evening.
The staff was very helpful and efficient.
We enjoyed the meal and the experience and will be surely back.

Whoa. I mean that in the best way what an awesome place & lunch we had!! This is a cool space, very nice servers and atmosphere and the food is OTT. We had (a salad, whatever itsa steakhouse), the angus tartare which was a huge portion but more important excellent texture & flavor, and the tenderloin filet poco hecho. Oh and the chimmichuri was awesome and I know because I make it all the time. THe only knock? Serve cava by the glass :) It was all sooo delicious seriously if you are a carnivore COME HERE!!

Every single thing I ate or drank was great during the meal. The service was good too. This is a tremendous value for what you get, it's chic enough to be great for dates and works well for business meetings. Highly recommended.

I was extremely impressed by the overall experience of this restaurant.

The atmosphere is great and the decor is classy. The food was extremely tasty, lots of options on the menu too. The staff were friendly and attended well to all their tables with a smile on their face.

Slightly more expensive than other restaurants in the area but worth it, in my opinion!

This was a really nice experience, as we had a table which was fairly private. The food and service overall was good although our starters weren’t served at the same time and I do think they had forgotten my scallops which were disappointing when they did arrive. This didn’t however spoil the experience though as I would go back here again if in Madrid, as the people were very welcoming.
